Nzvimbo irikuratidza kuti panenzira ino fambawo navanhu.  Nechemurutivi menzira iyi munewo miti pamwe chete nehuswa. Zvirikuita sekuti pane kasango karipo.

Pakati pemugwagwa uri kufamba motikari pane munhu aripo. Nechekure kwemugwagwa uyu asi kuri kurimativi kunedzimba dziri kubudikira dzemudurikidzanwa. Nechemberi ikoko kunoita sekune vamwe vanhu varikufamba.

Muti une maruva akatumbuka zvakanaka. Maruva aya akareba kudarika chikomo chemo uyewo aneruvara rweyero. Pane mamwe achiri pagirinhi asati atumbuka.  Poitawo mashizha aneruvara rwegirini. 
Pane zvimbuyu zvine ruvara rutema zvirikusveta muto kubva mumaruva.

Bhiriji ririmumugwagwa uri kupfuura nepariri .  Pabhiriji iri  pakaiswawo  simbi kuti mota dzikadonha dzisawira kuseri . Panoratidza kuti pazere marara.  Pamberi pebhiriji iri pane sora ririkuratidza kuti raoma riri kushaya mvura yakakwana.

Maradzano dzemigwagwa ine tara.  Migwagwa iyi iri kufamba motokari dzemhando  dzakasiyana. Nechekumberi kwacho tiri kuona nzvimbo yakavakwa zvakanaka inoyevedza ichiratidza  kuti inzvimbo inotengeserwa mafuta  edzimota.
Bhazi riri mumugwagwa rine ruvara rweyero. Rine mahwindo matema nenyanga yakarembera kumberi kwaro. Riri kumashure pegonyeti. Rakabatidza magetsi matsvuku kumashure
Imba yakavakwa ndokukomberedzwa nerusvingo  rwematombo.  Rwakavakwa zvakanaka uye maruva arikutevera rusvingo rwematombo.
Mugaisi aripamushina wekugaya akapfeka chinovhara mhino dzake akabata saga akamirira kuti zvipinde zvinogaiwa musaga iroro rakanyorwa nyorwa pamberi paro.

Musika wakamira pamberi pedzimba dzine matenga mapfupi. Une mabhanana aripo akarembedzwa nemirio iripo nezvimwe zvinodyiwa nevanhu. Pane dhishi riripo rakaiswa murio mukati uyeo chimusika achakavakwa nemapuranga

Muti wemurayimani unoratidza kuti kumusoro kwawo wanga watowoma.Asi muzasi memuti uyu muri kutungira mashizha egirini zvirikuratidza kuti pamwe mvura yakazonaya muti wanga wava pedyo kuoma zvino wakutungira.
Gonyeti rakatakura zvinhu paine chivakwa chine mafafitera akareba akawanda motokari ichifamba mumugwagwa unetara.
Mugwagwa urikudarika sepanoita sepachikoro chevana. Pachikoro Apa pane vanhu vaviri varikubidikira. Mumwe wavo akapfeka hembe chena uyezve pane dambiro revana.
Midziyo ine ruvara ruchena neruva rwebhuruu ine mazino. Inoshandiswa mumba kuita mabasa akasiyana siyana.
Ruoko rwemwanasikana mutema rune chuma chine ruvara rweshizha pane maruva aneruvara ruchena neyero negirini.
Miti yemi jakaranda nemaruva ayo. Mota dzirimumugwagwa dzirikupesana . Gonyeti , motokari yesirivha, kumucheto kwemumugwagwa kusina kushongedzeka.
Muti une mashizha ari madiki uye akasvibirira une mabukira matsvuku akatenderedza muti wese. Kudenga kwacho kunoonekwa mapazi akawanda.
Cheya tema inemakumbo matema nezvekutsamhira zvitema uye pekugara patema pakaputirwa neprastic. Pamashure payo pane mudhuri muchena yakagara paruviri rwakachenuruka
Mufananidzo makatorwa mudenga uchiratidza makore asimuka , ane mufananidzo unenge weBhiza. Kunze kwakati cheneyi, Rumwe ruvara ruripo nderwe buruu.
Pamharadzano dzomugwagwa.  Pane chikwangwani, seri kwechikwangwani ichi  kune miti yakasiyana. Imwe yemiti iyi mirefu asi mimwe mipfupi.
Motikari chena yerudzi rwerori yakamira parutivi pemugwagwa. Pamberi payo pane mavhiri matema pane munhu arikufamba achiyambuka mugwagwa achienda kuzvitoro zvakapfurirwa nemarata.
Motokari ine ruwara ruchena vazhinji vanoiziva vachiti kombi. Nechemuzasi ine ruwara rutema kumashure yakanyorwa nhamba namawara matema pachikwangwani chine ruwara rweyero.
Imba huru yakanaka. Ine denga rine ruvara rwutema uye yakapoteredzwa neruzhowa rwemiti yakadyarwa ikapfunzira ichichekererwa.

Vanhu vanoratidza kuti vari mudhorobha reHarare, pane motokari dzakawanda dzakapaka pachivakwa china magirazi akawanda, uyezve vamwe vazhinji vari kuenda panzvimbo iyoyo inoratidza kuti nzvimbo iyi pane chitoro chiripo chinonzi Pick n Pay panotengeswa magirosari emumba vamwe vanhu vakapaka vari kuratidza kuti vari kutotengawo pachitoro ichocho.
Michero yakarongererwa mumakadhibhokisi yakasiyana siyana iyo inodyiwa navanhu uye yakakosha pautano hwavo. Michero iyi yakaita samaranjisi manachisi uyewo mabanana.
Parengi. Pane mabhazi maviri. Rimwe ramabhazi rakapendwa noruvara rwebhuruu uye ruchena. Panewo murume akapfeka nhumbu tsvuku ane chingoro ari kutengesa aizikirimu uye navanhu vakawanda varipo.
Vana vechikoro, vakomana nevasikana. Avo vasikana vakapfeka zvakafanana zvitsvuku nezvitema kuzasi vari mudhorobha nevakomana vakapfeka..

Ndiro chena yakapakurirwa nyama.  Nyama iyi yakabikwa zvakaiswonaka ikaiswa matomatisi, makerotsi nemahanyanisi.  Pari kuonekwawo twumashizha twemuriwo.  Nyama iyi ndee nguruve zvichionekwa nemakanda ayinayo.

Mukereke vanhu vakagara pasi, kune mumwe chete arikutakura anoratidza kuti ndiye ari kuparidza. Pane vakagara pasi kune vanhu vakapfeka hembe ine ruvara rutsvuku koitawo vamwe vakapfeka hembe dzine ruvara ruchena
Gavakava riri pakati pesango rakakomberedzwa nemahuswa akawoma. Sango iri rine miti yakawanda ine mapazi akawanda. Mashizha emiti iyi ane ruvara rwegirini.
Matanda marefu anotaridza tambo dziri kumusoro dzemagetsi uye pane rusvingo ruripo rwakakomberedza nzvimbo iyi pamwe chete nematanda akaita madoko ari kunze.

Dzimba zhinji dzimwe dzacho ihuru dzinoratidza kuti dzakavakwa nemitoo yakasiyana. Nechekunze kwacho kune miti yakawanda zvimwe zvacho zvinoratidza kuti zvikwenzi zvakazobukira mushure mekunge miti mikuru yatemwa. Muzvikwenzi umu muri kubudira sora rakawanda rakaoma.

Mudzimai ari kuuchira maoko.Akapfeka risitibhendi chena.Mumusoro ane dhuku chena.Parutivi pake panamai vari kusekerera vakapfeka zvitsvuku nevamwe vanesheti yemachekidhi enevhi bhuruu nezvichena.Pasi pane pikicha yakanyorwa kunzi Precise seeking.
Murume ari kusvetuka achijaivha ngoma, haana hembe. Kuzasi akapfeka mhapa neshashiko yeminhenga yeshiri ina mavara machena, yero nebhuru.

Kamba, kamba inavana vayo vatanhatu varikuoneka. Vana ava vaneruvara ruchena neruvara rutema namakumbo akaita yero. Mai vekamba vanamakwanba makwamba ebhuruwu nematema nerimwe ruvara rweorenji kana kuti rweyero. Mumakumbo makaita ruvara rweorenji.
Muri murefu une mashizha aneruvara rwegirini. Uine matavi akatarangana akatarisa mativi akasiyana siyana.

Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari uyewo vanhu. Pane munhu ari kufamba achienda kwaanoenda. Nechekudivi kwemugwagwa kune fenzi iriko yakakomberedza nzvimbo ine motokari dzakawanda chaizvo dziri kutengeswa.
Munhu ari paruware. Mabwe makuru kwazvo. Mudhuri wakadonha. Muti une mashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Bundo rine ruvara rwegirinhi.

Vari kufamba zvavo mumugwagwa vamwe vari kufamba muzasi mezvivakwa nemotokari dziri mumugwagwa une tara dzimwe dzacho dzinoratidza kuti imotokari dzokutakura voruzhinji pane zvivakwa zvimwe zvemuturikidzana zvinobva zvatiratidza kuti mudhorobheni.

Vanhu vakapfeka hembe dzekutambisa mutambo.Vakamira vari vaviri vaviri vachidhonzana maoko.Hembe dzavo hadzina kufanana,vamwe vakapfeka dzakasiyana nevamwe.Uyezve shangu dzavo hadzina kufanana,dzakasiyana siyana.Vari kudhonzana maoko.Kunze kwenhandare kune vakagara pazvigaro vari kuona zvavari kuita.

Pamusika panotengeswa zvinhu zvakasiyana paneo vanhu vakawanda varikufamba vamwe vachitenga vamwe vachitengesa. Pane chingoro chirikusundwa chine masaga mukati. Paneo mudzimai akapfeka chikipa chichena akabereka mwana netauro rine mutsetse mitsvuku nemichena.
Chuma chakagadzirwa nesimbi chine ruvara rwesirivha.Chakagadzikwa pasi.Vamwe vanopfeka chuma ichi muhuro.Vamwewo ndivo vanochipfeka muruwoko.Chuma chinowedzera mucheno kunyanya kuvakadzi.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva pakati pedhorobha pane mugwagwa une motikari dzakawanda dzirikufamba. Pane imwe motikari chena yakamira parutivi pemugwagwa.
Kabati imwe chete ine masherufu mashanu. Ndeyemuti uye ine ruvara rwebhurauni. Parutivi pane chidziro chesimende.

Nzvimbo ine sora rakasvibira. Nechekumberi kune maruva akachekererwa zvakaenzana akakomberedza mudhuri wakavakwa nezvidhinha zvitsvuku. Nechokumashure kune nhokwe dzakasvibira uye mamwe masora akacheneruka.

Murume akapfeka hembe tema, nguwani tema nebhurugwa reruvara rwepfumbu. Akafuratira mataira  emotikari akagarisana ari matema. Nechekumashure kwema taira aya kune vanhu varikutengesa pamisika yavo vachitengesa zvakasiyana siyana zvinova zvimwe zvanga zvakachengetwa mumu gomo.
Ndiro imwechete yedhaga ichena. Ine chikafu chinoti mupunga wakatsvukira, nyama yehuku yakakangwa, mashizha epesiri nemuto wakagadzirwa nemadomasi nehanyanisi.

Munhukadzi akapfeka chuma muhuro make chine mipata mitatu iyo yakagadzirwa namachira nezvimwewo zvakasiyana siyana zvakare china mavara ane bhuruu, machena namatsvuku izvi zvinopfekerwa kushongedza miviri yavanhu.
Vakadzi vanofamba pachikoro. Vanoratidza kuti vadzidzi. Pamberi pavo pane zvivakwa zvokudzidzira zvine midhuri ine mavara machena kumusoro netsvuku kuzasi.

Chingoro chakamira chiri padivi pebhazi. Chingoro ichi chine ruvara rwebhuruu uye chine mufananidzo wechinwiwa chepepusi. Padivi pechingoro ichi pane dutavanhu rekambani inonzi Rimbi, dutavanhu iri rineruvara rwebhuruu uye rakanyorwa namavara matema.
Zvinyoreso zviviri zvine ruvara rutema kumashure uye ruvara rwedenga mberi zvinoshandiswa kunyora pamabhodhi.
Murume akamira pedo nemadziro ane ruvara rwebhuruu. Akabata bhegi muruoko rwake aine bhachi mune rumwe ruoko. Akapfeka hembe yakaita chena aine matenesi mutsoka dzake nemudhebhe murefu.
Ruoko rwakabata rosari imwechete. Ineruvara rwesirivha irikuvaima, uye yakagadzirwa nesimbi.

Panoiita sepachivanze pemusha, pane mbudzi hono mbiri  dziri kufamba.  Mbudzi idzi dzine ruvara ruchena uyezve dzakasimba. Nechekure kwembudzi idzi kune dzimwe mbudzi ina dzakarara panoiita sepamberi pemba.
Bhiriji rakawakwa ne masimbi akawanda uye rakareba kwarinoperera kune huswa hwegreen nerimwe sora rakaoma miti yakareba uye ine mashizha mudenga mune makore mashoma ari machena

Mdziyo inoshandiswa mumba yakarongedzwa kuti itengeswe.Inosanganisira inosanganisira inoshandiswa kuchekesa miriwo nemichero kuti iyite midiki iyo ine ruvara rwebhuruu.Koitawo ndiro dziri kumativi dzine ruvara rwesirivheri.
Maturo ebasa akagadzikwa pasi pane ruvara rutema. Maturo aya ane mibato yeruvara rwebhurauni yakagadzigwa nemapuranga. Nechekumberi yakavenzengwa ine ruvara rwesirivha ruri kuvaimira.

Pane migwagwa miviri inosanganisira mugwagwa wevanhu uyezve mugwagwa wemotokari. Mugwagwa wevanhu, pane munhu arikufamba ari oga mumugwagwa umu. Kozotowo mumugwagwa unofamba motokari kune motokari mbiri dziri kupesana.

Mumugwagwa une tara murikufamba motokari dzakasiyana dzinosanganisira mota diki, magonyeti nebhazi. Mujinga memugwagwa mune dzimwe motokari yakamira mubvute inoratidza kuti ino iri kumirira kutakura vanhu.

Nzvimbo ine matombo mazhinji anoratidza kuti akapfumba. Pamusoro pemamwe  tirikuona pakavata mbudzi dzinoratidza kuti dzine hukama sezvo dzine ruwara rwakafanana uye dzakazemberana zvadzo dzichiratidzana kuwirírana kukuru.
Mudzimai akasunga dhuku mumusoro uyewo akabata nhare mbozha arikuteerera. Akabatawo muchiuno.
Motikari yerudzi rwekombi, ine ruvara rwesirivha, ine mavhiri matema. Yakamira parutivi pemugwagwa pane masimbi matema.
Zvibeke  zvakasiyana zvakatsvetwa pamusoro petafura zvinoratidza kuti zvitsva nemhete nezvuma zvakagadzirwa nenzira dzakasiyana.  Zvunhu zvose izvi zvinoratidza kuti zvitsva uye zviri kutengeswa.
Mupopo murefu uri pamba pakakomberedzwa nerusvingo paine denga remba ririkubudikira.

Bhasikiti tsvuku rinoisirwa hembe dzakachena kana kuti dzakasviba. Bhasikiti iri rakagadzikwa pamusoro pemucheka uneruvara rwebhuruu neruchena. Mubhasikiti umu munehembe dzakazara uyezve rinemuvharo mutsvuku.

Chitofu chinowanikwa mumba mokubikira chinoshandisa gasi kuti chishande. Chakanaka zvikuru uye chinoratidza kuti chichiri chinyowani. Pekubikira pacho pane ruvara rwesiriveri uye pakati pacho pane goridhe . Chinoratidza kuti chinogara mapoto maviri. Muviri wayo une ruvara rutsvuku uye kumwe kwakatenderedzwa nezvitema. Chine pamwe pane chiruva chine mavara eyero.
Chikiti chine ruvara rwerupfupfu nemizera michena chine maziso ane ruvara rwerupfupfu nzeve dzaro ichena.
Badza rakagadzirwa nesimbi uyezve rashakara, rine mupinyi webango.  Badza iri rakagadzikwa pasi  pamahuswa ane ruvara rwegirinhi uyezve richinoita kakuchenerukira.
Chirimwa chemhiripiri chakairwa ivhu musaga chinemashizha asvibirira uyewo  chabereka,panemhiripiri imwechete iya isinganyanyovava yerudzi rwe girini.
Zvingoro zvakapakwa panzvimbo inevhu dzvuku.  Zvingoro izvi zvakagadzirwa nesimbi uye zvine ruvara rutema. Kumberi kwazvo Kune huni dzakatemwa dziripo.   Kumativi kune vanhu vari kufamba.
Zvinhu zvekutengesa zvinosanganisira nzungu, madomasi,  dovi, uyewo pane zvitinha zvakaturikidzaniswa. Vanhu vakagara nemumwe ari kurudyi  akagara akabata masaga maviri jena nere girini.

Datya rine mavara mavara. Rineruvara rweginhi robva raita mavara machena. Rinemapundu mapundu aneruvara rwuchena. Maziso aro, rinoratidza kuti rinemaziso matsvuku. Datya rinowadzowanikwa nguva yekunaya kwemvura.
Motokari imwe chete doko ichena yakamira pedyo nemudhuri une fafitera rakavhurwa.  Pasi pane sora shoma regirini uye netumatombo tudoko twakasangana nemavhu tuchena.
Pakati perimwe dhorobha pane vanhu vari kufamba. Vanhu ava vari kupfuura pamberi pemisika. Mumwe wemusika waka waridzwa shangu pasi. Kozoti umwe wemusika wacho wakawaridzwa mabhuku.
Motokari  dziri kufamba mumugwagwa wetara. Nechekurudyi kune mumwe mugwagwa wemavhu wakazarawo marara une mitiwo nechekudivi kwavo. Pakati pawo pane miti mihombe nemidiki.
Dzimba, matanda emagetsi tambo dzemagetsi, tiranzifoma uswa hwakaoma miti dzine mashizha akasvibira uye mamwe akaoma.

Nzvimbo inehuswa hwakasvibira uye ine miti yakawanda. Panoonekwawo nzira inofamba ichipinda nemukati memuti. Kumberi kwemiti kunoonekwa jurahoo ririko. Uyewo mukati mejurahoo munoonekwa kuti muneimba ine mataiwo matsvuku.
Pakati pekuguta pane dzimba dzemunhurikidzwa nemotikari dzakawanda dzakamira navanhu.
Paruvanze pane maruva nezvekutambisa zvevana nebhutsu.
Munhukadzi arikuteka mvura pamugodhi. Mudhuri wakavakwa nezvidhinha uye une marata. Mugwagwa unofamba motokari.
Vakomana vaviri vanoita zvemutambo wekurwa. Mutambo uyu unoshandiswa maoko namakumbo. Vakapfeka nhumbi dzakafanana. Nhumbi idzi dzine ruvara ruchena  dzobva dzaita mabhande muchiuno.
Pane sango rine miti yakawanda. Sango iri rine miti mipfupi nemirefu. Musango umu zvakare mune huswa hwakawanda. Kwozotiwo mudenga mune makore arikuratidza sekuchanaya.

Kabhasikoro kenhema nhema kemuimba yekugwinyisa muviri. Kanochovhewawo zvenhema kasina kwakari kuenda kuti ari kushanda nako agwinye muviviri. Karipo zvako hakasati kave neari kushandisa kakatongodzima zvako. Kanoratidza kuti kanozoshanda namagetsi kana ochovha munhu.

Mudzimai arimumvura akabata hari yaari kudira mvura yaachera murwizi.  Mudzimai uyu akarukwa wigi yaka reba ineruvara rutema.  Akapfeka zvishongo zvechinyakare uye zvirikuratidza kuti arikuita zvemashave.
Munda wakarimwa makabhechi ayo anoratidza kuti asvika panguva yekunge achikwanisa kudyiwa navanhu. Anobatsirawo vanhu kuti vange vachidya pamwe chete nekuwana mari kana achinge atengeswa.
Mukati medhorobheni mune zvitoro zvakarunda mugwagwa. Chimwe chezvitoro ichi ndechinotengeswa mushonga chiri padivi pacho ndechinotengeswa mbatya.

Vatambi vemutambo wenhabvu varikuseshena. Vakapfeka zvikadabura zveyero nehembe dzegirinhi kumusoro nemasokisi matsvuku nebhutsu dzakasiyana-siyana makara. Varikumhanyira munhandare munesora regirinhi.
Muriwo we(cabbage) wakawanda une mashizha mahome uye nevana vakakura. Pamusoro pane tambo dzemagetsi uye pane muti uri parutivi wakakura uye usina mashizha.
Mureza wekunyika yeSouth Vietnam uyo uneruvara rwenhundurwa rwakautenderedza. Nechepakati pawo pane maraini arikubva kurudyi achienda kuruboshwe ayo aneruvara rutsvuku.
Munhu akapfeka nguwo dzine ruvara rutema kumusoro uye dzine maoko madiki nemutodo une ruvara rwakacheneruka nechekumusoro nekusvibira nechekuzasi.
Chikafu chakabikwa zvamandiriri chiri mundiro chena. Pane nyama yanatsokugochwa zvakanaka. Mavhoko akachekererwa zvakanaka, hanyanisi, tomatisi, mapoteto, gaka netumupungawo pakona pendiro iyi.

Musikana mushava tsvarakadenga. Nyangwe tisinakuona kumeso kwake asi unongoona kuti musikana akanaka akageza akashambidzika zvakanaka. Anevhudzi rake rakasvibira zvakanaka. Akashongedza musoro wake zvakanaka. Anemhete nechishongedzo chemusoro zvakafanana. Musikana uyu akapenda nzwara dzake dzemuruoko nependi yebhuruu.
Matengi emvura akagadzikwa pamatombo.Parutivi pacho pane miti.
Vanhu varikufamba vari vechidzimai, vachidarika nepasi pemiti ine mahunde akakura uye ine mabukira epingi. Vakatarisa dzimba dzakavakwa dzine matayera matsvuku

Vakadzi vakapfeka mbatya dzakafanana vakaita zvitaera zvakasiyana kuti mufananidzo wavo ubude zvavanoda. Vese vakapfeka mbatya nhema dzine tumabhotai tuchena uyewo vari pamberi  vese vakagwadama. Vari kumasure vakaisa maoko muhombodo.
Imba isirikunyatsooneka. Irikungooneka kumberi kwayo nekudivi. Hatisi kuona zviripamusoro. Yakavakwa pakaunganidzwa mavhu., uye pane zvakaita kunge zvidhina zviripo. Kumberi kune zvimwe zvivako.
Vakomana vezvingoro vari kufamba  mukati meguta. Umwe wacho akapfeka hembe chena nemutirauzi mutema. Akasungira chibhegi muhuro.
Chivakwa chemapuranga. Parutivi pane maruva akadyarwa mumagaba. Maruva aya ane mashizha akasvibira.
Chivakwa chine ruvara rutsvuku parutivi pane muti wakakura usina mashizha, uye gedhe rakagadzirwa nesimbi rakazara ngura.

Vanhurume vanotamba mitambo webhora varikuonekwa vakabata zvipfuva zvavo veri mumutsetse nechekumhiri kuri kuonekwa zvituro zvine ruvara rutsvuku nezvine ruvara rweyero nerwe girini kune vanhu vakamira ikoko umwechete akagara pasi.

Mudzimai ari kufamba. Wakabata bhegi rine ruvara ruchena. Kumusoro akapfeka hembe ine ruvara rwakachenerukira kuzasi kune hembe ine ruvara rwepingi. Mudzimai uyu muruoko akabata nharembozha ine ruvara rutema.
Munhurume mumwe chete anofamba. Akapfeka hembe yepepuro kumusoro nebhurukwa zasi. Akabereka bhegi ritema. Mumusoro akapfeka ngowani. Parutivi pake pane chidziro cheyero.
Pane wadhiropu yakagadzirwa nemapuranga iripo. Wadhiropu iyi ine magonhi akawanda. Uyezve wadhiropu iyi ine fafitera riripo kozoti makabati ekuvhura

Dzimba nhatu dziri pamufunanidzo yeuswa iri pedyo, uye ine imwe nzvimbo isisisna huswa inoda kugadziriswa. Mwana arikutamba nematayi arikufamba achibva pamatayi. Marara akaraswa-raswa pachivanze.
Maturuzi anoshandiswa kugadzira mudziyo yemumba akagadzikwa pasi, maturuzi aya akagadzirwa nesimbi uye ane mubato wepuranga.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti idhorobha pane zvivakwa nepakagadzirwa pekupakira mota pakapaka mota ipapo nepakamira mumwe murume pakagadzirwa zvakanaka pane ruva regirinhi neroni yegirinhi.
Chaunga chavanhukadzi vanoratidza kuti vari pamusangano. Vanogona kunge vari vechechi yeZCC ndiyo inopfeka yunifomu yakadayi.
Imba yakapfirirwa nehuswa. Ine chekurasa hutsi padenga payo. Kumberi yakavakwa nema(tile). Uyewo ine pekuisira rambi kana kuti(light) padenga paro.
Imba yakavakwa nezvidhinha nesemende. Ine denga rine ruvara rutema. Chidziro chemba iyi chine ruvara ruchena uye kuzasi kune ruvara rutsvuku. Imba iyi ine mafafitera maviri nemukova mumwe chete.
Munhukadzi akamira pakati pemvura. Akatakura gate rine mvura yaari kudurura murwizi. Uyewo maoko ake akashongedzwa nezvuma. Zvakarewo ane zvimwe zvuma muhuro make. Bvudzi rake rakakura uye idema.
Muti womugondekonde wakareba. Urimusangohombe rine miti inemashizha akasvibira uye rinesora rakasvibira nerimwe rakaoma.

Mune imwe ndiro ine ruvara rutema makaiswa chikafu chemhando yepamusoro. Chikafu ichi chinosanganisira mbatatisi uye nyama yakatsvukira. Mundiro imwe chete munoita semune muriwo uye hanyanisi dzisina kuchekerwa.
Patafura pane ndiro yebhonzo ine nyama yakabikwa zvakanaka ine muto wakatsvuka. Parutivi pane muriwo une ruvara rwegirinhi namatomatisi akachekwa.
Buwe rine muviri unemutarazi mitema nemipfumbu riri kufamba paivhu makumbo aro akakwirira kudarika mutumbi, mutumbi uzere nemvere pamwechete nemakumbo ayo.
Miti dzakawanda dzakakura. Umwe una maruva  akawanda ane ruvara rwepepuro. Pasi pane uswa hwakawanda uye hwakaoma  hune ruvara rwebhurauni.
Musitoro munotengeswa maphone nezvimwe zvese zvinogona kushandiswa pa phone. Uyewo pane mukadzi ari kutengesa akasunga dhuku chena uye ari kusekerera.
Komichi yekushongedzwa mumba yakabatwa. Inemavara-mavara  machena, bumhudza koita zvakare goridhe. Nechekumusoro kwayo kuneruvara rutsvuku rwakaikomberedza.
Masora emutsanga akamira akasangana nezvimwewo. Uyewo ane ruvara rwegirinhi uyewo pane mimwe mitsanga yatosimba poita imwe ichiri mitetetete. Pane zvimwewo zvimatombo zviri kuoneka zviri pakati payo.
Munda wakarimwa ma cabbage akawanda.  Ma cabbage aya ana mashizha  makuru uye ane ruvara rwe girinhi.  Mudenga mune tambo dzamagetsi dzirikupfuura nepakati pemunda uyu.
Muti wakavakwa pamberi pechivakwa chiri kuita kunge chikuru chine mukova nedhoo jena nemahwindo akawanda.

Nechekumucheto kweumwe mugwagwa unofamba motokari kune motokari dzakamirako. Nechemberi kwemugwagwa uyu kurikuratidza kuti kune dzimba dzemudurikidzwana. Pakati pemugwaga uyu pane vanhu varikufambapo.

Iyi nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inzvimbo inotengeswa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana zvinosanganisa mabhanana, mbatya nemasagi. Uyewo panemunhu arikufamba hake achitengesa zvidhori. Uyewo vanhu varikungozvifambira zvavo, vamwe ndovarikuda kutenga

Nzvimbo yakanyatsoshongedzwa inoratidza kuti pane muchato.Panzvimbo iyi pane mabharuma akashongedzwa zvine hunyanzvi.Mabharuma aya ane ruvara ruchena mamwe ane ruvara rwebhuru koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rwakarerekera kupingi yakachenerukira.Nechemukati kunoratidza kuti kune tafura yakanyatsoshongedzwa chaizvo.
Mota dzirifamba mumugwagwa, pasi panemarara. Dzineruvara rwesirivha nemutsara webhuruwu. Irimberi ineruvara rwemeruni uye mavhiri matema. Padivi nechekurudyi, pane kadhibhokisi rakabvaruka mberi.
Zviumbwa zvemibato yemaoko zvinodaidzwa nezita rokunzi mbiya. Mbiya dzaka turikidzaniswa dzimwe dziri Ina ina dzimwe dziri shanu shanu.
Mupunga nenyama zvakabikwa zvinoyevedza, zvakasanganiswa pamwe chete madomasi nehanyanisi zvakashandiswa kubika muto wenyama unonaka mupunga wakachena kuti ngwee kunge mukaka.
Zvivakwa zviri. Chimwe chakavakwa neruzhowa rwakagadzirwa nesimende. Chinamafafitera maviri. Chimwe chakavakwa nezvitina chine ruvara rwekirimu.
Tumiti twakachenukira twumwe tune ruvara rwebhurauni twune mashizha maduku aneruvara rwegirini inekayero.Pazvimbo iyi pane twumashizha twakawanda twakadonha twune ruvara rwebhurauni.

Nyati huru inoratidza kuti ibhuru yakadambuka imwe nyanga yekudivi  rwekuruboshwe ichiratidza kuti inenge yairwa neimwe ikadamburwa nyanga.  Nyati iyi ine kumeso kwakaunyana nemuviri wakafuta ine ruvara rwakasviburuka uye zheve dzacho dzakabvarurwa kuratidza kuti yairwa.
Shangu mbiri dzeruvara rwe gireyi. Hadzisungwi netambo pamusoro, dzine chibhandi chekudzishongedza. Mukati madzo makandoita gireyi yakasvibira.  Dzaka dhirowewa zvimoyo kumashure kwadzo kunodzika.
Vanhu vakagara pamusha urikuvakwa. Padivi pemusha uyu pane miti miviri yemumango yakareba, uye miti iyi ine mashizha akawanda ane ruvara rwegirini.
Pamusika parikutengeswa mbatatisi. Mudzimai wakamira akapfeka hapuroni yakati chenerukire nemurume wakapfeka hembe tsvuku nebhachi rine ruvara rwedenga risina makore.
Mureza une mavara matatu akasiyana.  Ruvara ruri pazasi rutema. Ruvara ruri pakati ruchena. Ruvara ruri padenga rutsvuku.

Mureza unomiririra imwe nyika unoratidza kuti unemutaro mutsvuku unobva kumusoro kusvikira zasi. Kozoita mamwe mavara anosanganisira ruvara rwamashizha nanyoro divi rokumusoro. Kozoita ruchena pakati uye ruvara rutema divi rezasi.
Mune imwe nzvimbo pane vanhu vakamira pamberi pengoro inotengesa zvinwiwa. Umwe wavarume akamira apa akapfumba maoko. Kwozoti nechekumberi kwavo kune imwe mota yakavhura gonhi.
Mufananidzo wegava wakaiswa pabhuku pachishandiswa penzura unoratidza musoro nechipfuva chete chete.
Ruzhowa rwakashongedzwa rune mudhuri wakaiswa ruvara rwakajeka ruchena muviri wese netukirimu. Panewo gedhi rakaiswa ruvara ruchena nesimbi dziri pamusoro paro dzine ruvara ruchena.

Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa ne waya. Mukati menzvimbo iyi mune muti mukuru wakakombodza wakasvibira . Muzasi memuti uyu munoratidza kuti unogarwa nevanhu vakazorara zvavo vachitonhorerwa nemubvuti wemuti uyu. Sezvo wakakombodza wakasvibira chose.
Kurutivi kwemugwagwa uri kufamba motokari, kune sumburera dzakavhara musika pedyo pemisika iyi pakamira bhazi dzvuku rakanyorwa padumbu, kozoti necheparutivi pebhazi iri  pane chikwangwani.
Murume mumwe chete akamira akabata bhora muruoko rwake. Mutambi webhora remumaoko. Akapfeka yunifomu yebhuruu ine mavara machena. Shure kwake kune motokari dzakamira.
Pane vanhu vakagara parukukwe kozoita mumwe mudzimai akapfugama parukukwe iroro achigadzika chikafu chikafu ichi chakapakurirwa mundiro dzedongo chimwe chezvikafu zviripo magaka Asina minzwa

Motikari nhatu dzakapakwa kumashure kwemajojo tank maviri. Pane motokari wo yehonda fit, toyota wish ne probox. Zvinoratidza kuti vanhu vakapaka motokari idzi varikuchera mvura inobva mumajojo tank aya anoshandisa mahinjini kupomba mvura.
Komicho yegirazi inetumapundu mapundu kumativi asina kusvika kumusoro. Ine chimubato.  Yakagara pamusoro  pezvimubato zvemapanga. Irimushopu mune midziyo yemumba neimwe yepurasitiki.
Amai vakabata ruva vachiripfekedzera paakaungana vachinyemwerera vakabata muchiuno, pedo pavo pane vamwe vakamira vakatarisa.
Pane munhu anoratidzika somunhurume ari pekati pemamwe maruva akamurebera. Murume uyu akakotama akabata heti uyezve akapfeka hembe nomudhebhe.

Mugwagwa wetara. Kuruboshwe kune service station yakanyorwa kunzi Total Energies. Kumberi kunoonekwa dzimotokari dzakawanda dzirimumugwagwa uyewo kurudyi kwemugwagwa kunoonekwa masolar anoshandisa zuva.
Vanhu varikusimudza tutsapo twavo kubva pamusika apa vachienda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana. Ngoro mbiri dzakasendekwa kuita chamupidigori.
Nzvimbo yakagadzirwa yakanaka chose ine miti namaruva zvakachekererwa zvakaenzana, uye zviri zverudzi rwe girini zvakapfumvutira pane nzira yakasiiwa yokufamba nayo yekuti undobuda nekugedhi.
Rimwe divi remudhorobha.  Rine midhuri ine mahofisi akasiyana-siyana. Mimwe mirefu mimwe mipfupi.
Ndiro dzematanda dzakaiswa chikafu chakasiyana chinosanganisira matomatisi akachekerwa zvakanaka nezvimanhanga zvidoko zviya  zvinodaidzwa  nevazhinji kuti bhata nati

Vanhu vagere pazvigaro. Vamwe vanenguwo chena vamwe zvitsvuku. Arikurudyi anenguwani ichena mumusoro make. Vanoratidza kuti vane zvarikunyora pamapepa, aripakati akabata chinyoreso. Varikumashure vakataririra munhu arikutaura arimberi, uye kune miti nesora.
Pamharadzano yemigwagwa,pane motokari dziripo kusanganisira imwe nhema.Nechokunze kwomigwagwa,kune zvikwangwani zvakati wandeyi zvakaiswa.Zvikwangwani izvi,zviri pedyo nechidziro.
Mirongo miviri yemavise,mavise maviri mahombe.Vise iri rine ruvara rwegirini uyezve rine mitsara inotevedza vise iri yakasvibirira.Rimweni racho rakachekwa mukati maro mutsvuku  nemhodzi dzichena.

Chitima chiri munjanji. Chine ruvara rwegirini noruvara rutsvuku. Muna vanhu vakaburitsa musoro nepahwindo. Pane mudoko mwana akaburitsa musoro nepahwindo ari kumberi, kwoita wechikuru muchena wakaburitsa musoro nepahwindo zvakare.
Muti wakamera pakati pematombo,  muti werudzi  rwemunzwa unamashizha akasvibirira.  Matombo aya akakura chose uye akapatsanuka akati rimwe uko rimwe uko.
Sora rakasiyana siyana rakawanda rine ruvara rwegirinhi uye rakanatsosvibira. Parutivi pane mudhuri uneruvara ruchena.
Mudziyo unoshandiswa kuvesera moto vanhu vachibika kana kugocha zvinhu zvakaita sechibage , nyama Kana zvimwe zvinhu zvose zvinogona kubikwa pamoto wakagadzirwa nesimbi wakamiswa pamadziro eimba.
Chigadzirwa chakagadzirwa nemiti kana kuti namatanda chikatsvetwa pekugara pane ruvara  rweyero nepekuzembera.
Ndiri kuona bundo regirinhi nehozhwa iri pamusoro pebundo irori.

Bindu rechimanjenjerinenge rakapfirirwa nemapepa anopinza zuva. Munorimwa zvirimwa zvakasvibira zvinenge zvinenge zvakagadzirwa zviri mumutsetse yakanaka. Mune munhu akapfeka nguwani ine ruvara rwegoridhe.
Musango mune miti diki dzakawanda, dzimwe dzina mashizha dzimwe hadzina. Ruvara rwama shizha rwunoti girini, tsvuku, bhurauni.

Mumunda unoratidza kuti wakambenge makarimwa muhomba yembambaira ikatsokodzerwa.  Mashanga akaenda pakati pemuhomba uyezve pane pakapiswa. Pana matombo akawanda. Matombo aya pari kuratidza kuti pane zvinoitwa nekuti pakatsokodzwa-tsokodzwa. Kune miti yakawanda ine raruva rwegirini.  Mukati muri kuratidza kuti mune dzimba dzakavakwa. Pane iri kuonekwa ine  ruvara rwebhuruu nedenga ine ruvara richena.
Varume nevakadzi vakapfeka mbatya dzekereke  yechiPositori. Murume uri mberi unotaridza kumiririra uye kutangamira madzimai ari kuombera maoko kutaridza kuti vari kurumbidza Mwari.

Vanhu vari kufamba panzvimbo  inowanikwa mudhorobha. Pane mazisimbi ari  pamusoro ari kuoneka. Uyewo pane pamwe pakamiswa zvitanda zvakafanana zvine ruvara rweyero nepamwe patema. Uyewo vanhu vacho vari kuda kuyambuka mugwagwa kuenda kune rumwe rutivi.

Chibhazi chisina kunyanyokura chinotakura vanhu. Chiri pamugwagwa chinotova nevanhu vari mukati. Bhazi iri rineneruvara ruchena, girini nemutaro weyero. Panewo motikari inoendawo rimwe divi ineruvara rutsvuku nezvichena.

Parutivi pemugwagwa pane murume arikukanda nhanho achiita seari kumhanya.  Nechekuseri kwake murume iyeye kune ruzhowa rwe simbi.  Mukati meruzhowa urwu mune imba irimo yakanyorwa padumbu.  Seri kwemusha uyu kune miti mirefu.

Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari, uyo unoratidza kuti hauna tara. Nechekudivi kwemugwagwa uyu kunewo dzimba dzakavakwa ,kwozoitawo motokari yakamira pamwechete neimwe. Dzimba dzichiri kuratidza kuti dziri kuvakwa.

Nzvimbo yemudhorobheni inezvitengeswa tengeswa zvakasiyana siyana, vanhu varipapa vanoratidza kunge vekumagaba.Panotengeswa mabhara,zvigubhu, mabhaketi,matengi emagasi nezvimwewo zvigwandangwanda zvingangodiwa mudzimba.Panoonekwazve matengi akutakura uye nekuchengetera mvura  mudzimba.
Mudzimai akapoda-poda, akarukwa obva aiswa bvudzi rakareba mumusoro. Tsiyo dzake dzakagerwawo, muromo wakapendwa. Akapfeka rokwe rineruvara rweyero asi rinosiya makadza ari pachena.
Imba yakapendwa negireyi ine juraho netuu madhishi. Kunze kwejuraho kune mota yebhureki.
Mudhorobha motokari dzizhinji dzirikufamba. Parutivi pane munhurume mumwechete arikufamba. Kumativi kune chivakwa chakakura chakagadzirwa nezvitinha zvine ruvara rutsvuku.

Muchitoro mune zvinhu zvakawanda-wanda. Pane sherefu inezvinhu zvine ruvara rwepingi nemarepin'i pepa akareba akaputirwa egoride nesirivha. Kuruboshwe kune mabhokisi akashama akawanda. Pasi pane mamwe ane zvebhuruu nezvegireyi.

Vanhu vanopinda chechi yepositori vakaungana pamba pavari kunamatira. Vamwe vazhinji vakapfeka zvichena,kwoitawo vamwe vakapfeka hembe dzavo dzemhando dzakasiyana uyewo vese vane madhuku mumusoro kunze kwevana vadiki nevanhurume.
Rudzi rwemotikari inodaidzwa kunzi gonyeti  uyewo iine ruvara ruchena. Yakanyorwa pavhiri reruboshwe kuti " whitehill". Kumashure kwegonyeti iri kunoonekwa miti yakasvibira zvikuru.

Mudzimai arikufamba achipfuura nepadivi pemurume arikusunda chingoro chine mabhaketi. Mudzimai uyu akarukwa madhiredzi ane ruvara rwe bhurauni. Akapfeka nguo yokumusoro ine ruvara rweyero nechikabudura chine ruvara rutema.
Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa neruzhowa wedurawall negedhe dema, pane muti una maruva eYero nezvimuti zvidoko zvava kusvava zviri muzasi , pedyo negedhe  pane maruva epepuru uye pane muti uri padivi.
Mukati momusika munotengeswa sauti, mazepe nemaputi. Munevanhu vanofamba kusanganisira vakadzI vaviri vakabereka vana kumusana.

Vanhu varimunhandare varikutamba bhora. Munoratidza kuti mune ma timu maviri, evakapfeka zvitsvuku nevamwe vakapfeka zveyero zvine chikabudura chitema . Uyewo varikumhanya vese vachida kunowana mukana wekukava bhora.

Mutambi akamira pakati penhandare, nhandare ine huswa hwakachekererwa zvakanaka mutambi akapfeka zvipfeko zvokutambisa bhora ane sikipa yake chena ine mitaro mitema pama pendekete, akapfeka chikabudura chitema chine mitsara kumativi.
Chinyu chiripakati penhekwe mbiri nemachira. Pane reretso nemamwewo , rimwe rebhuruwu nerimwe rehanga.
Muti wemuchero unoratidza kuti muti wemumango wakatsva mashizha arikuratidza kuoma. Une maruva uye une mamengo madiki ari kukura. Mashizha aya ava neruvara rwakandochenerukira.
Vanhu vakagara pasi pemumvuri yemuti. Nechekushure kwawo kune dzimba dzakakomberedzwa nemajurahoro. Mberi kune migwagwa miviri yetara. Pakati payo pane mavhu akaparadzanisa migwagwa iyi.
Sango rinovonekwa miti yakawanda uyewo matombo akawanda. Pane huswa hushomanene humwe hwakasvibira nehumwe hwakaoma. Kumberi kwematombo kunoonekwa mazimiti mahombe anemashizha akasvibira.

Motikare irirkufamba mumugwgagwa usina tara inedzimba kunerumwe rutivi. Dzimba idzi dzirikuwoneka ma tenga zvishoma, Uye wo kunemiti yakakomberedza mugwagwa. Mugwagwa uyu awuna kuiswa tara asi pane motekare irikufamba po ichiyenda. Unoratidza kuti panepamwe  pawunosvika uchipasanuka uchenda kunzvimbo mbiri.
Pane imba yakavakwa zvakanaka. Imba iyi ine rimwe gonhi rakavhurika, uyezve imba iyi ine mafafitera akawanda. Imba yakapfirirwa nema tiles, uyezve pedyo nayo pane miti.
Vanhu vakagara vari kutengesa zvinhu. Kumberi kunoonekwa rori yakamira yakanyorwa kumberi kunzi "TITAN", uyewo murume akamira padanda remafoni.
Mune imwe nzvimbo, mune migwagwa miviri, umwe mugwagwa ndewekufamba kwevanhu kozotiwo umwe mugwagwa urikufamba motokari. Mugwagwa wemotokari une motokari zhinji dzirikufamba mauri.
Pamusoro petafura. Paita bhodhoro risati rwavhurwa rinechinwiwa chineruvara rutema icho vanhu vanowanzo dana kuti Koko. Chinoita kuti vanhu vambotapirirwa mumuromo.
Mureza wekunyika yeCuba uyo unemaraini maraini aneruvara rwebhuru nezvichena, nechemuruboshe kwaro kunechiratidzo chetiraiengo chineruvara rutsvuku kozoitawo kachiratidzi kachena karikubudikira.
Imba ine pendi yepingi yakapfirirwa nema taira matema, muvhuranda mune tafura pane ketero yesirivha, muberere mune bhasikoro bhizautare revana  vaduku chivanze chakatsvairwa asi chine uswa hushoma.
Nzvimbo yokutengesera, mabhegi akaturikwa ari kutengeswa nehembe dziri pamatafura. Munhu ari kutengesa.

Vanhu varikufamba mumugwagwa wakatarisana nezvitoro. Pane mwana wechikoro akapfeka yunifomu yake uyewo kapfeka juzi pamusoro neshangu nemasokisi nenguwani mumusoro. Akapakatira bhege uye ari kufamba ari ega.

Turusi inoshandiswa nevanhu vechirume kana vanhu vechikadzi vanogadzira matepi emvura. Inonzi bhobhojani. Turusi iyi ine kakurema kainako uye ine zvimazino nechivhiri pakati zvinoshandiswa kusunga sunga.
Zviumbwa zvedhaka zvakapiswa, hadyana, shambakonzi, zvipfuko mbiya dzirikutengeswa.
Musikana arikunyemwerera akapfeka dhuku re bhuruu, ne rokwe reruvara rweshizha. Anenge akagara pamusoro pomugomo.  Zvinoratidzika  sokuti arikutorwa mufanikiso.
Hozva ine mavara eyero nebhurawuni. Iri pasi. Inofamba mbichana mbichana.
Shangu dzechidzimai dzine ruva rakachena pamusoro idzo dziri dzebhuruu uyezve dziri pasi pakachena.
Mune mumwe munda unoita seune mashanga uripedo nedzimwe tsanga. Mune huswa hwakaoma . Nechekumhiri kune mugwagwa urikupfuura nepazambuko. Kwozoti seri kwezambuko iri kune miti yemibhanana.
Charles Manyuchi uyu mutambi mukuru wetsiva akabata mabhereti nemamedhau zvinoratidza kuti akakunda pamitambo yakawanda.
Chivakwa chikuru,  imba ine mipanda yakawanda hombe. Yepa chikoro chikuru chokudzidzira, pane munhu mumwe chete panze .

Varume vari kuyimba vari pagungano vakatariswa nevanhu. Vamwe vevarume ava varikuridza hosho umwe ari kuridza ngoma. Vari kuratidza kuti vari kufara uye vakapfeka nguwo dzine ruvara rwakasiyana kumusoro.
Chindarira chemumaoko chechirume chitema uye chine masimbi esirivha chakagadzikwa pachituro chine ganda ritsvuku.

Vanhu vari mudhorobha vakagara pabvute reimba. Vachiteengesa zvirimwa zvakasiyana siyana mumwe ari kutengesa madomasi mumwe mahanyanisi . Zvirimwa izvi zvinoratidza kuti zvakaibva uye zvakasvika.  Panewo vamwe vakamira vari kutenga nekuona . Koita vanhu vari kungofambawo zvavo vachikwidza nekudzika.

Chimuremwa -remwa chine ruvara ruchena chakamira chiri chega.  Kumeso kwacho chakwada kuita sechimhuka chinenge  chinguruve uye chine zvinzeve zvakamira.  Chine zvimakumbo zvine nzara dzinopara uye chine makushe.  Miremwa- remwa inodonha nhata dzinogona kutoruma vanhu zvekutovatadzisa kugadzikana zvakanaka uye ine zvimapapirowo zvokuti vanhu havazivi kuti imhuka here kana kuti ishiri.
Zvimiti zviduku zvenhundurwa zvakabereka nhundurwa dzakawanda dzeyero.  Pasi pane masora akaoma ebhurauni.

Nzvimbo ine sora zhinji rakaoma nemiti mikuru iri kuratidza kuti iri kuzunza mashizha  sezvo iine mashizha akatsvukuruka nemashizha akawanda pasi payo, zvinobva zvaita tifunge inguva yechando sezvo nguva iyi iriyo inoshayiwa utano uswa nemiti sezvo kusinganayi mvura yakawanda nguva yechando.
Hangaiwa nhatu dzirimuchikwere. Dzinemuzera yakafanana uye dzineruvara rwakasvibira rutema.
Mudziyo unoshandiswa muhofisi, tafura yakakura yepuranga ineruvara rutema. Chigaro chakakura, chine ruvara rutema.
Mhuri iyi yashanyira masvingo eZimbabwe.  Masvingo aya akavakwa zvine unyadzvi.  Pakashandiswa hwendefa dzamatombo dzisina madhaka.

Vanhu vechechi yerudzi rweJohani masowe, mapositori anopfeka zvishongo zvichena vakadzi vanosunga dhuku chena refu mumusoro varume vanopfekawo magemenzi machena, vanhu ava vanonamata vari panzvimbo isina kuvakwa.

Mutambi wenhabvu anoratidza kuti ari kudzidzira kurova bhora riri pakona yenhandare. Achangobva kurova bhora negumbo rake reruboshwe  neshangu yake ine pasi pegirini. Murume uyu akapfeka hembe yebhuruu nekabudura yebhuruu zvakare.
Zvirimwa zvakamera panzvimbo imwe chete zvakasangana mando dzakasiyana,zvese zvine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini.Zvimwe zvabuda ruva  rakaita rine ruvara ruchena.

Vanhu vazhinji, vazhinji vanoratidza kuti vakadzi vakasunga madhuku machena mumusoro vamwe vacho vane maBlouse machena zvekare. Zvichiratidza kuti vanhu vari pamusangano we chechi, uye vanotendera chitendero chepositori.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti pane mafuratsi panogara vanhu vakawanda. Mumwe mudhuri urikuonekwa wakapendwa nezvegirinhi, ende pane zvakanyorwa pamadziro aya. Parikuonekwawo  hembe dzevana dzakayanikwa panze.

Besanwa vanhu vachifamba mudhorobha. Vamwe vakabereka mabheke kumusana vamwe varikungofamba vamwe vakabata mabheke mumaoko. Vamwe vakamira vakatarisa kune vanodarika. Vamwe vanotengesa zvimwiwa zvakarongedzwa pamakadhibhokisi.

Bindu rinembesa dzinofanira kunge dziridzemakabheji dzichiridiki dzegirinhi. Zvinoratidza kuti mbesa idzi dzinowana chikafu chakakwana uye dzirikudiridzirwa mvura inodzikwanira kuti dzikure zvakanaka.
Tarakita ndere kurimisa mubindu, riri kuratidza kuti rinobata basa mazuva mazhinji , mataya aro ane madhaka, ane ruvara rweyero nerutema iro ndere girini.

Vasikana vaviri vakamira vakabatana miviri yavo.  Vasikana ava vakapfeka nguwo dzakafanana. Vakapfeka makepesi aneruvara rwebhuruu uye sikipa dzineruvara rutema, girinhi uye yero. Vakapfeka zvikabudura zvipfupi zvineruvara rutema.
Mukati meguta munoonekwa zvitoro zvakapendwa neruvara rweyellow uye zvinyorwa zvinoshambadza zvinotengeswa muzvitoro izvi. Ichi chinotengesa mishonga yekurapa vanhu, chiri panosangana nzira.
Bhazi rakakura. Rinotakura vanhu vakawanda panguva imwechete. Bhazi racho rine mavara mavara uye rakanyorwawo zita rekambani padumbu.
Masvosve emhando yamajuru ayo akawanda, ose ana mavara egoridhe  uyewo ari mubishi rekutora ivhu pasi achivaka churu.

Pamusika panotengeswa zvigadzirwa zvakasiyana siyana. Vanoshandisawo zvingoro samatafura uye maamburera makuru kudzivirira zuva. Vanhu vanobva kunzvimbo dzakasiyana siyana vanosvika panzvimbo iyi vachitenga nokutengesa zvakasiyana siyana.

Ndiro yakaiswa chikafu chakabikwa zvinoyevedza. Chinoratidza kuti chakabikwa nematomatisi nehanyanisi sezvo chakatsvukira. Muchikafu umu munosanganisira mupunga nenyama inoratidza kuti inyama yemombe yakatsvukira chose.
Pene mumwe mugwagwa uripamberi pezvitoro. Pane munhu arimukati mengoro irikudhonzwa nemadongi. Madongi aya maviri, uye aneruvara rwepfumbu. Nechekure, pane hurongwa hwemakireti ezvimwiwa.

Vatenderi vechitendero chechi Positora. Vari pagungano ravo pane jecha. Vakapfeka zvipfeko zvavo zvichena nezvimwe zvina mavara akatsaukana anenge majuzi. Kungangova  kuri kutonhorera, iri nguva yamasikati. Pamwe mazuva echando. Vanenge vari kuimba  kana kunamata.
Mumugwagwa unofamba motokari mudhorobha kune murume  akapfeka nhumbi nhema ari kuiita seari kusunda chimwe chinhu. Nechekunze kwemugwagwa uyu kune dzimba dzemudurikidzanwa.

Musika werudzi rwechitema ari kuratidza kuti ari munzvimbo inotengeswa zvinwiwa. Akapfeka dhirezi rine ruvara rutsvuku uye ruvara ruchena 
uyezve akabata bhegi rine ruvara rutsvuku neruvara rwebhuruu nepepuro. Mumusoro make akarukwa madhiredzi.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba inoratidza kuti inofambwa neveruzhinji. Nechekumwe rutivi kuri kubuda mudhuri unoratidza kuti wakakomberedza nzvimbo ine dzimba. Mujinga memudhuri uyu mune munhu wakagara akapfeka heti. Pamberi pake akatsveta kadhibhokisi akaisa zvinhu pamusoro zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa uye pane vana vakapfeka ma "uniform" vari kuratidza kuti vanoenda kuchikoro uye vari kuda kutenga zvunhu zviri kutengeswa nemunhu uyu.

Ndiro chena inoratidza kuti yakagadzra nemagodo, ine chikafu chakabikwa neunyanzwi. Muchikafu umu munosanganisira sadza rakabikwa neupfu hwemabarwe machena rakabhakwa zvakanaka rikaita chibhora, parutivi pacho pakuratidza nyama yakabikwa ikavhenganiswa nemakabhigi nematomatisi akatsvukira chose
Jagi rine mavara egoridhe pamwe chete nendiro dzedhaka. Midziyo inoshandiswa muimba yokubikira kupakurira zvekudya pamwe chete nekucheresa mvura.

Vanhu vari kufamba mudhorobheni vanoratidza kuti mudzimai nomurume wake uyo akabereka bheke. Pane mugwagwawo wetara unofamba dzimotokari nemotokari dzakapaka pabvute remiti iri kumhenderekedzo rwomugwagwa.
Chigayo chinogaya zvinhu zvakawanda. Chinoratidza kuti chinogayo chakakura. Chine ruvara rutsvuku nesimbi ine ruvara rwegireyi iripo.
Pane madzimai maviri varikupfuura pachitoro chakanyorwa kunzi Edgars. Madzimai aya arikuratidza kuti  akananga kune mumwe mugwagwa wakamira motokari. Nechemberi kwavo kunewo vanhu varikuzvifambira.
Pamusika. Tswanda dzine mizera  yakafanana, Dzakawanda dzine ruvara rwebhurauni . Imwe chete ine ruvara rwebhuruu . Dzakazara nezvekudya zvakaomeswa.
Pane imwe ndiro yakapakurirwa chikafu chinoyevedza. Ndiro iyi ine chikafu chinosanganisira nyama yemombe, mbatatisi kozotiwo miriwo yakaiswa nechapamusoro.
Pasi pane marara akawandisa uye zve mataera matatu akafa nematope, Parutivi pane motokari navanhu vakamira.
Mudhorobha mune masitoro akawanda. Munewo vanhu vari kufamba. Pane mudzimai akapfeka chijaketi nemutirauzi rejini akabata kabhegi katsvuku mumaoko make uyewo akagadzirwa mumusoro.
Mutokari dzirikufamba pamugwagwa. Padivi panemiti dzakawanda, dzimwe dzinamashizha egirini, dzimwe dzisina uye miti dzimwe dzinemaruva aneruvara rwepepuro.
Nzvimbo inovezerwa midziyo yemumba mubhedha wakagadzirwa wakaturikidzana pamusoro nepazasi. Mubhedha wakadai unowanzogadzirirwa vana uye wakapendiwa neruvara rwebhurauni.

Pakati peumwe mugwagwa pane vanhu vari kufambirapo. Nechekumativi  emugwagwa uyu kune vanhu vari kutengesa misika. Vari kutengesa vanosanganisira vamwe vanotengesa mabhanana. Pane vanhu vari kufamba mumugwagwa pane mumwe murume akabereka bhegi dema.
Vanhu vanoratidza kuti vanoita mitambo yechinyakare uye yakarerekera kumitambo yemidzimu sezvo vakapfeka machira matsvuku nekuzvisunga netambo mumisoro, vakaisa zvuma zvikuru muhuro.

Chidziro chakagadzirwa zvakanaka, chakaputiridza dzimba uye mukati mechidziro munoratidza miti mikuru zvikuru ichiva yemimango. Chidziro chacho chinoita kuti mbavha dzinetseke kupinda uye zvinoita kuti vanhu vagare zvakanaka pasina vekunze vanoona zviri mukati

Vanhu vanopinda chechi yechipositori vakamira vari pamba. Vazhinji vacho vakapfeka mbatya chena uyewo pane vakamira vachida kutorwa mufananidzo vari vanhurume vega. Vamwe vakabata musoro, vamwewo vakabata magemenzi avo, vamwewo vari kuratidza kuti vane zvavari kutaura.

Pamugwagwa wetara panemotokari dzakamira dzakafuratirana. Imwechete irikuonekwa yakatarira kurudyi, chena nechekuruboshwe kunemotokari dzakati wandei dzakamira mberi kwedzimba. Imwe imba inemadziro eruvara rwebumhudza imwe inemadziro eruvara rwegoridhe. Imba idzi dzakakwirira uye dzimwe dzirikuonekwa nechekumberi kwemugwagwa.

Nzvimbo ine mugwagwa uyo usina tara, inoratidza kuti unofambawo vanhu kana kuti dzimotokari, hauna zvawo kunyanya kukura. Pari kuratidza kuti panorasirwa marara navanhu uye zvakare panewo chivakwa chiripo chiri kuratidza kuti pane zvinoitwa navanhu

Muzasi mechidziro chejuraworo. Umo makagadzirwawo mukadyarwa maruva  ari kuratidza kuti ari kuwana manyowa pamwe chete nemvura yakakwana.  Izvi zviri kuonekwa nekukura kwaari kuita achinyatsoshongedza nzvimbo iyi.
Maruva emhando imwechete. Ane mashizha akawanda uye madiki akasvibira neruvara rwegirinhi. Rinewozve amwe mashizha ane ruvara rwepingi madokodoko mashoma.

Maruva akanaka akaisiwa muzvigaba zvinoratidza kuti ndezvakagadzirwa kuisa maruva. Maruva aya akasvibira anoratidza kuti anodiridzwa. Chigaba chimwe chokutanga makaiswa magavakava maviri anoratidza kuti ave nenguva arimwa sezvo areba uye magavakava aya anoratidza kuti aneutano anodiridzwa nguva
Motikari dziri kufamba dzichipesana mumugwagwa  wetara . Parutivi pane muti wakasvibira uye une zimumvuri zihombe. Pane ivhu dzvuku.

Nzvimbo iri pedyo nemugwagwa une tara.Ine huswa husina kunyanya kukura.Huswa hwacho hwakaita kutsvukuruka.Panewo miti ine maruva.Maruva acho matsvuku uye mamwe akada kuita pingi.Mashizha emiti iyi ndeegirini.
Mango dzakatsvuka dzenyaka diki dzakaunganidzwa panzvimbo imwe chete.Dzakatemwa mumuti kuti dzigozodyiwa.

Nzvimbo yemudhorobheni inoratidza kuti inoshandiswa kuhodhesa zvinhu. Inofanirwa kunge iri hurusero nekuti zvinhu zvirikuonekwa zvinwiwa nezvimweo zvirimumakatoni kuti zvigotengeswa. Pane vanhu varikupinda nekubuda kundotenga zvinhu izvi.
Varume vana vakamira muberevere rezvitoro. Panharaunda iyi pane zvikwangwani zvinozivisa uye kushambadza. Vanhuwo zvavo vamwe vakamira vachivanda mvura inoratidza kuti yanga iri kunaya.

Vanhu vakufamba zvavo mujinga mezvidhori zvakapfekedzwa hembe itsva dzirikuratidza kuti dzirikutengeswa. Pavanhu apa pane murume akapfeka heti nechivhara mhino chiya chinoshandiswa kudzivirira dzimbwa rekorona. Akapfeka mudhembe mutema nesikipa tema inemaoko mapfupi.
Chibeke chakanaka chinoratidza kuti chakaita zvokurukwa uye chakarukwa  nenyanzvi sezvo chakanaka. Mujinga mechibeke umu makasendekedzwa bhasikoro riya rinozivikanwa nevazhinji kuti sipoti bhaiki.
Mufananidzo wemukomana akapfeka chikabudura chitema kumusoro ane mbatya chena netsvuku. Ane chuma muhuro akapfeka zviwoneso zvinopfekwa nevanhu vanorwadziwa nemaziso.

Shiri yakamhara patambo nhema. Inogona kunge iri tambo yemagetsi. Ine ruvara rutema nepamwe pachena. Ine makumbo mapfupi nemusoro usina kunyanyoreba. Shiri dzinodyiwa nevanhu. Dzimwe dzinofamba dziri mbiri mbiri. Ukaona ichifamba iri imwe chete imwe yacho inenge yakafa.
Chikoro chinoratidza kuti chiri kutorwa vanhu nekuda kwekunyorwa kwakaitwa, nevakadzi vaviri vari kufamba vachibva kuchikoro ichi. Mukati macho mune miti mikuru.
Sango rine miti yakawanda  mirefu, ine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirini nerwegoridhe, miti yacho mipangara ine minzwa inobaya.

Shangu ine ruvara rwakaita pepuro neruvara rwebhuruu nemufananidzo weNike.Pamberi pane rumwe ruvara ruchena nemumucheto weshangu kwekutsikira.Mukati mune ruvara rwakaita bhurawuni.Shangu iyi inoratidza kuti ndeyekugumbo rekuruboshwe uye inoratidza kuti ndeye munhurume. Yakagara pasi pane ruvara rwepfumbu.

Chivakwa chakavakwa nezvidhinha zvitsvuku uye pamberi pacho kana kuti kumativi kwakajarwawo maruva  ari kuratidza kuti arikudiridzirwa chaizvo. Izvi zviri kuoneka nekukura neutano hwaainaho. Maruva aya akajarirwa kuti ange akanakisa nzvimbo.
Musha une dzimba dzakawanda wakakomberedzwa neruzhowa rwehwaya. Parutivi parikuonekwa miti ine mashizha akasvibira.
Churu chine ivhu dzvuku chakatuta chakazembera muti une hunde yakakora. Nechekumberi kuri kuoneka masaga emabhero edonje

Vanhu vazhinji asi vazhinji vacho vadzimai. Vari kuratidza kuti vari kuturena kana kuti kudzidzira mitambo yetsiva sezvo vazhinji vacho vakasimudza makumbo mudenga vachitevedzera zviri kuitwa nemudzidzisi wavo ari kumberi anoratidza kuti inyanzvi yetsiva sezvo akatopfeka hanzu dzokutamba tsiva.
Muchivakwa mune vanhu vazhinji varikufamba. Pasi  pakagadzirwa namataira ane ruvara runoti chena, bhurauni nenhema

Madhikauzi kana kuti mhete dzekuisa panzeve kushongedza nzeve dzevanhukadzi aya ane ruvara rwegoridhe namadhaimani nematombo amadhaimani uyezve mamwe akaita sama bhatafurayi aripanzvimbo dzakasiyana siyana dzenzeve.
Munhukadzi akazvisungira dhuku rake. Ari kuratidza kuti munhu ari kutaura pafoni asi ari kuratidza kuti haana mufaro nenyaya yekuti haasi kana kusekerera.
Vanhu varikufamba panzvimbo inotengeserwa. Varikufamba vachienda kwakasiyana. Nzvimbo iyi ine misika yakawanda ine ma sumburera pamusoro ane ruvara rwakasiyana.
Mudhuri wakavakwa zvemunhurikidzwa wakaenda mudenga , nemafafitera akasvibira. Pamberi panemukadzi akapfeka zvitema akasenga bhegi mumusoro.
Mumba yokutandarira. Mune zvigaro zvakakura. Zvakagadzirwa namatehwe zvitatu zvinoonekwa netafura yedenderedzwa iripakati.

Munhu ari munhandare arikuratidza kuti arikutsigira mutambo. Akasimudza mureza unoratidza kuti ndewemhando yedivi raanotsigira. Kumashure kwake pane chikwangwari chiri kutengesao mabhodhoro edhiringi rinonzi Pepsi. Murume uyu ane musoro une rasita.

Munhu akabata mukombe akamusimudza mudenga kuratidza kuti arikupemberera kukunda makwikwi kwavanenge vaita vakawana mukombe uyu.Vakapfeka hembe inemaoko marefu yakaita chena uye akaisa menduru muhuro.
Miti iri kubudikira ine mashizha egirinhi. Jurahoro rakavakwa nezvidhinha zvebhurawuni, masimbi akapendwa nebhuruu.
Ngoro yakatakura mapuranga yakamira pakati pemugwagwa. Nechekunze kwemugwagwa kune imba yemapuranga inoratidza kuti haina gonhi kana fafitera. Pasi pengoro iyi pane marara.
Ndiro chena ine sadza, nyama yakapiswa mumafuta, murio wemashizha, matomatisi akasanganiswa nemakaroti nebhinzi dzegirinhi huye svumhu iri padivi.
Pedyo nemumwe mugwagwa pane dzimba dzezvitinha dziripo. Dzimba idzi dzirimukati mewaya padzimba idzi pane dzimwe dzidiki nedzimwe dzihombe.
Munhu kadzi akapfeka hembe ine ruvara rwe pingi yakanyorwa pamberi nezvichena.Musoro wake wakarukwa mabhuraidzi ane ruvara rutema ayo akarembera achidzika nemumapfudzi.Munzeve dzake mune mhete.
Mudzimai akapfeka yunifomu yegirini.Pachipfuva chayo pane mureza weZimbabwe.Mumawoko akabata mukombe kana kuti mhenduro inoratidza kuti akunda mumakwikwi eCOSAFA evechikadzi.
Muchinjiko, parutivi pane munhu akamira akasimudza maoko. Kurikouneka zuva riri kupenya richipenyera pamuchinjiko uyu.
Pane musha wakaiswa magetsi uripo. Musha uyu une gonhi nemafafitera akavharwa.   Seri kwemusha uyu kurikubudikira muti.   Nechemuzasi memusha makapendwa ne pendi tsvuku.

Varume vanoita zvekutamba mitambo. Mutambo uyu unoratidza kuva mutambo webhasiketibho. Varume varipo vakapfeka umwe wakapfeka nhumbi dzebhuruu neshangu chena. Mumwe wacho achibva apfeka zvisho zvipfeko zveyero neshangu tema. Pane vanhu vakawanda varikuratidza kunge varikutamba mutambo.

Mugwagwa wakapamhama une tara mumugwagwa umu muri kufamba mota dzakasiyana dzine marudzi akasiyana dzimwe itsvuku dzimwe ichena kusanganisira bhazi rekwa c.a.g rine kumberi kwakaita kuchena nekumasure kwakaita girini nechekumberi kwacho tiri kuona miti mikuri yakasvibira yemupaini.
Muti mumwechete wakakura,  une mazhizha akawanda  uye akasvibira.  Pazasi pane bindu remuriwo  wakawanda uye una mashizha makuru akasvibira
Midziyo yemumba mekutandarira aya masofa  aneruvara rutema kwekuzembera akaiswa madhizaini pedowo nemasofa pane motokari iripo.
Mukomberedzo wemba wakagadzirwa neruva rinokura richitanda richienda mudenga. Ruva iri rina mapazi akawanda uye mashizha akawanda ari mapfupi ane ruvara rwegirini.
Panzvimbo pakatimbiwa timbiwa pane sora riripo, apo pakatimbiwa  pakaisiwa mupfudze, panoratidza kuti ibindu ririkugadzirwapo, vanhu vanodyara murivo kana miti mumapindu.
Huswa hwakawanda kwazvo hunoratidza serudzi rwuya rwehuswa hunoreba huchienda mudenga asi kuti hwakawiswa pasi nemhepo. Huswa uhu ndehwe ruvara rwebumhudza uye hwakawanda pahuri ipapa.

Nzvimbo inoratidza Kuti i nzvimbo yeruzevha. Pamusha pane vanhu vamwe vakagara mumwe munhu arikufamba . Panedzimba,  imwe inoratidza kuti Imba yekubikira ine uswa neimwe inoratidza kuti  Imba  yekuvata yakapfirirwa neuswa. Pane chigaro uye pane ivhu rine ruvara rwe bhurauni.
Ruva rine mashizha matete ane ruvara rweyero nematavhi emaruva aya matete-tete akareba achienda mudenga. Nechepazasi paro panoratidza kuti pane mapundo akaoma.

Vana vechikoro varimunhandare inenge yebhora. Nhandare iyi inoratidza kuti inhandare diki uye nechekumashure kwacho kune chikomo chakagadzirwa nematombo akagarisana asina kubatana asi akakura kwazvo. Mune vana munhandare umu  vakapfeka nhumbi dzakafanana.
Varume vatatu vanoratidza kuti ndevechikuru vakamira. Vose vakapfeka midhebhe michena nemahembe anemaoko mapfupi anoruvara rwakaita ruchena. Umwe wacho akabata tsvimbo neruoko rwake rworudyi.

Mukomana mumwe chete wechidiki wechitema akafuratira. Akapfeka nhumbi dzine ruvara rwegirini uye yakanyorwa kumusana neruvara ruchena. Padivi pane ngoro dziripo uyezve kumberi kwake kune vanhu varikufamba.
Motokari dzirikufamba mumugwagwa.  Imwe yerudzi hweHwonda fiti. Inoruvara ruchena. Miti inemaruva aneruvara rwepepo. Motokari ine ruvara rwesirivha.

Ndiro yakagadzikwa pamusoro petafura. Ndiro iyi ine ruvara ruchena uye yakapakurirwa chikafu chakabikwa zvemandorokwati. Mune hove yakakangwa ikatsvukirira uyewo mune maavho, matomatisi, mbatatisi, mupunga nezvimwewo zvinonaka.
Pane mukadzi ari kufamba mune imwe nzira ine vanhu vakawanda akabereka mwana. Mukadzi uyu anoita kunge akabata zvinwiwa zviri mupepabhegi kune rumwe ruoko.
Mufananidzo wemaruva akadyarwa nesora riri kuwonekawo mukati akasiyana siyana ane mavara egirini mamwe akati svavirireyi arikuwoneka powo.
Tenisi rine ruvara rutsvuku mukati nekunze rine rabha rine ruvara ruchena rine kabhadhe pamusoro ndere kugumbo rerudyi tenesi ishangu inopfekwa kuchitonhora.
Mabhegi akasiyana siyana ane mavara akasiyana siyana zvakare. Mamwe mabhegi ane ruvara rutsvuku mamwe ndoane ruvara ruchena namavara matema. Koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rweyero neruvara rutema.
