Nzvimbo yakapfumba zvikuru inoratidza kuti inofambwa neveruzhinji.  Tiri kuona mukadzi  ari kuratidza kuti ari kufamba akapfeka heti huru chose kuratidza kuti anovhara zuva.  Akasimudza gumbo rake rokuridyi achiratidza kuti ari kufamba akabata mbozhanhare noruoko rworudyi rweruboshwe rwakabata bepa.

Mumadhorobha mune dambudziko rezvifambiso zveve ruzhinji, zvinoshomeka. Kune motokari dzinotakura vanhu dzisiri pamutemo dzerudzi rwemaToyota Wish. Idzi mota dzinembiri zvakanyanya uyezve dzinotsindira vanhu vakawanda.
Nyemba tsvuku idzi dzakananikwa pazuva. Dzadururwa kubva mumugomo wesirivha. Mukati menyemba idzi mune dzimwe nhema.

Nzvimbo yakaunganidzwa huni dzakawanda.Huni idzi dzinogona kushandiswa pakubika kuitira kuti vanhu vasangogare vachishandisa magetsi.Asi padzinotemwa panoda kungwarirwa kuti mimwe miti isare ichidyarwa kuitira kuti vanhu vasazoite dambudziko rekushaya miti.
Vanhu vakawanda vanoratidza kuti vari kukereke. Vazhinji vavo vakapfeka magemenzi machena uye mukadzi aripo akamira akabata ruoko kune mumwe munhu, mukadzi uyu haana kupfeka zvakafanana navamwe.
Matengi maviri emvura akavakirwa pamatombo. Pane tengi rineruvara rwegirinhi, pozoitowo tengi rineruvara rwebhuruwu. Matengi aya ane kwaari kuendesa mvura. Nzvimbo yacho yaari inowomiti yakakura.
Murume akagara akapfeka nguvani tsvuku nemumwe akapfeka zvichena arikuseri kwake vari pazvitoro zvidiki zvine zvikwangwani pamadziro
Nzvimbo inenge dhorobha ine zvivakwa nemotokari dzirikufamba nevanhu vane madhiringisi arikutengeswa mapepusi nemamirinda.

Shumba nhatu dzinoratidza kuti dzine hukama sezvo dzakamira dzakagumhana izvo zvinobva zvaita kuti tifungidzire kuti huru yacho ndiyo mai dzimwe mbiri vana. Padzakamira pane sora rakaoma rinoratidza kuti rava nenguva yakareba risina kunaiwa nemvura zvichibva zvaita tifungidzire kuti inguva yechando kana nguva yechirimo.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva pakati pedhorobha, pane vanhu varikufamba vachipesana, pane mudhuri wakavakwa zvemunhurikidzwa

Nzvimbo inogara vanhu vakawanda inoratidza kuti inzvimbo yemudhorobheni, pane dzimba dzakawanda dzirikuratidza kuti dziri kuvakwa uye dzavakunopera kuvakwa nedzimwe dzakapera kuvakwa dzine marata nemavara akasiyana pane maraiti emumugwagwa uye pane ivhu rine ruvara rwebhurawuni neuswa humwe hwakapiswa.
Zvivakwa izvo zvinova zvitoro zvinoshandiswa navanhu kuita mabasa akasiyana siyana koitawo zvikwangwari zvakanyorwa munoitirwa mabasa aya kozotiwo vanhu varikufamba vachienda kwakasiyana.
Maruva akaiswa mumapepa matema epurasitiki akaunganidzwa. Mamwe achiri madoko anemashizha mamwe anemaruva abukira aneruvara rwepepuro.
Mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari urikuratidza kuti haunawo tara, unosimuka huruva panodarika motokari. Kozoitawo munhurume akamira. Uyezve nechekumativi kwemugwagwa uyu kune miti nehuswa.
Vanhu vechikuru vakagara zvavo pasi vachiratidza kuti vari padare pamambo sezvo pana mambo akapfeka gemenzi rake riya  dzvuku nengowani mumusoro. Vamwe vose havana kupfeka ngowani.
Munhu murefu akapfeka chikweshe arikufamba akatarisa kuimba yemudurikidzwa muguta.
Pane ndiro chena yakaiswa kudya kwamandorokwati. Ndiro iyi yakaiswa kudya kunosanganisira nyemba dzinoita kunga dzakamonwa nemugoti. Kwozoti pamusoro pane miriwo iripo isina kubikwa.
Madzimai maviri vari kuepsana pakufamba, vose vakapfeka madirezi, vamwe vakabvisa ruvara rutema rwemumusoro rwebvudzi vakaisa rumwe ruvara rweBurauni. Vakabereka mabege pamativi avo.
Zvigadzirwa zvinoshandiswa pakugeza injini yemotokari.  Zvakatsvetwa pasherefu  zvichitengeswa.  Iyo sherefu yacho ine ruvara ruchena. Zvigadzirwa izvi zviri muzvigumbu zvine ruvara rwegirini.

Imba yakavakwa panzvimbo isina vanhu vakawanda. Imba iyi ine denga rine ruvara rwegirini uye chidziro chine ruvara ruchena. Padivi payo pakamira motokari huru ine ruvara ruchena zvekare. Yakakomberedzwa nehuswa hune ruvara rwegirini uye zvikwenzi zviri kumativi.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inzvimbo yeruzevha. Vanhu vakagara vanoratidza kuti vari pamusangano. Vakapfeka zvipfeko zvine mavara akasiyana. Vakagara vamwe pamabwe vamwe pasi. Pane huswa hwakoma huneruvara rwebhurawuni.

Murume ari kufamba achipfuura napamarobhotsi akatarisana nechingoro chiri kutengesewa zvimwiwa. Murume uyu akapfeka kepesi dema uye akapfeka juzi kana kuti jasi rine ruvara rutema nemavara machena kumusana. Akapfeka mutirauzi une ruvara rutema.
Mugwagwa miviri inemhararano. Mumwe mugwagwa urikufamba motokari. Mugwagwa urikufamba motokari uyu wakavharwa nemasimbi mapfupi ane ruvara rwuchena nerwutema Pane murume akazembera imwe simbi.
Midziyo yamagetsi anonzi ma speaker akawanda.  Anoiswa panzvimbo dzakasiyana kuti nzvimbo imwe ne imwe inzwe zvinenge zvichibuda mu speaker iyoyo.  Matema, pane mapfupi namarefu.

Muti wemubhanana wakadonhera kuseri kwezen'e.  Zvakadonha zvacho matanda nemashizha. Zvine ruvara rwebhurauni rurikuratidza kuti zvakaoma.  Pamusoro pematanda pane mamwe mashizha aripo ari kuratidza kuve  girini.  Mashizha akadonhera pamusoro petsangadzi ine ruvara rwegirini uyewo pane kamwe kashizha kari kubuda pazasi pemashizha akaoma emabhanana.
Panoita sepakati pedhorobha, pane mugwagwa uri kufamba motokari nevanhu. Kumativi emumugwagwa uyu kune miti mirefu uyezve dzimba refu dzine makamuri akawanda.
Zongororo rakazvimoneredza moneredza. Rine ruvara runopenya penya. Rwakaita pepuru, bhureki nehukushe hwakaita pfumbu.
Pane varume vaviri vari kufamba mumugwagwa wevanhu uri pedyo nemugwagwa unofamba motokari. Nechekure kune musha wakavakwa nezvidhinha ukapfirirwa nemazen'e. Varume ava vanoita sevari kutaura nyaya.

Varume vaviri vari kuratidza kuti vari kufamba mujinga mezvitoro sezvo vakatotarisa muchitoro munoratidza kuti muri kutengeswa shangu. Varume ava vose vakapfeka midhebhe mumwe akapfeka mutema nesikipa tema neshangu dzine tsvunha yeNaiki dziri chena.
Munda uzere mhunga. Mhunga iyi yakadzvarwa nguva yakafanira nokuti yese yakanyatsokuita girini. Panoratidza kuti ivhu iri  rine chikafu chakakwanira mbesa iyi zvokuti inokura zvakanaka.

Maruva aneruvara rwegirinhi mamwe ane ruvara ruchena akawanda. Uye kumberi kune miti mikuru ine ruvara rwe girinhi neuswa.  Nechepakati panoratidza kuti pane pakaita gochi. Kumberi kune miti mizhinji, rimwe rutivi kune matombo arikuonekwa ariko.
Mushina wemhando duku unoratidzika semutsva, una mavara ebhuruu muviri wese nezvichena, ungangodaro uri mushina wekugaya zvinhu zvakangoita semichero kana mirivo yamarudzi akasiyana siyana.
Musikana akarukwa mhotse, iye ari mutsvuku akapfekawo hembe tsvuku. Akaisa zvitanda zvokuteerera munzeve.
Dhorobha guta guru rina mabhiridhingi akareba.

Vanhu vanoita zvekunamata chitendero chechi kirisitu vakamira mumba yokunamatira. Vamwe vakapfeka mbatya chena nemabhande matema mamwe ari pamatundundu poitawo mamwe ari  muchiuno ane zvinenge zvimabakatwa zvakaiswa parutivi.

Mudhuri wakavakwa nezvitinha nesemende uneruvara ruchena. Pamusoro pemudhuri uyu pane dhishi riripo rinobata masaisai ekuti vanhu vaone pachivhitivhiti. Kunze kune zvikwenzi namaruva zvineruvara rwegirinhi.
Musoro wemunhu akagerwa chezvizvinozvo mushava uye  munhu uyu ane nzeve hombe.
Mutambo wetsoro yechess urikuratidza kuti urikutambwa uye makwikwi makuru sezvo pane chiringazuva parutivi chirikuratidza nhambo kana nguva dzemutambo uyu nebepa nebhiro irikunyorwa parutivi.
Chikafu chemupunga chakasangana nembatatisi nemadomasi uyewo ne sumu nenyama yakabikwa  zvakanaka.
Hembe dzemunhu rume dzakapfekedzwa pachidhori. Pane nguwani tema, hembe refu ine mudhebhe mukati zvine ruvara rwakasvibirira mabhatani necheni.
Mufananidzo kana kuti chiumbwa che ndege chakagadzigwa. Kumberi kwacho kune danda rakadonha rine ma posita evanhu vezvematongerwo enyika.

Rori ine ruvara ruchena. Rori iyi yakakura chaizvo. Nechemurutivi yakanyorwa namavara matema. Inoratidza kuti inotakura zvakasiyana siyana ichienda nzvimbo dzakasiyana. Rori dzadai dzogona kutakura midziyo yemumba dzogona kutakura zvakare midziyo yekuvakisa
Ndiro chena yakaburirwa chikafu chemhando yepamusoro-soro chikafu ichi chinosanganisira mupunga ,nyama yehuku yechidya,makarotsi, bhinzi dzegirinhi nezvimwewo zvakachekererwa mundiro iyi.
Dzimba dziri mukati mechidziro. Dzakaiswa mapatani mapatani padenga uye dzakapendwa nependichena   nependitsvuku padenga pacho.
Murivo wemhando yekorifurawa unokura uchiita kunge kavichi asi iwo pakati pawo panozobuda rinenge ruva jena. Murivo uyu unokurudzirwa kudyiwa nekunzi unonzi unopa utano.
Pachiteshi pane vanhu varikutengesa mazitye, pamwe chete nevanhu varikuratidza kuti varikutotengawo, pane makombi arimo mukati pamwe chete nevanhu varikupesana vachienda kunzvimbo dzkasiyana siyana.

Maruva aripachirokari akawanda. Pane mamwe anemashizha akareba akatesvera ane ruvara rwegirini nezvimwewo zvichena koita mamwe akarebenuka zvikuru koitawo mamwe arimuchigaba anodyiwawo semuriwo, zvakare akanaka.
Uyu mucheka wetayiendidhayi unogadzirwa uchiiswa pendi nemimwe mishonga uchiisa ruvara rwaunoda kugadzira jira iroro. Unogadzirisa nhumbi dzakasiyana-siyana.

Miti mikuru yakakombodza yakasvibira iri kuzuka mashizha. Muzasi mayo mune tumwe tumakwenzi zvakare tune mashizha mashoma mamwe mazhinji acho akatsvukuruka zvichibva zvaita kuti tifungidzire kuti inguva yechando kana nguva yechirimo.

Chitima chirikufamba panjanji.   Chine ruvara rwe girinhi.  Uyewo kumusoro kuchena.  Kumusoro wacho Kune pamwe  patsvuku nechepazasi.  Mune vanhu vaviri varimo.  Mukuru akabuditsa musoro  uye akapfeka nguwani.  Koitawo.kadiki kamunhu kakabuditsawo musoro zvekare.
Mvuu zhinji dziri kufura zvadzo munjinga medziva neNzou mbiri dzino ratidza kuti dzakura sezvo dzine nyanga refu. Dziri kufurawo neMvuu idzi.

Tsangamidzi dzakaunganidzwa kuti dzitengeswe.  Dzakaiswa pachisaga. Uyewo pane tunzungu tune munyu turi muzvipepa.  Pane vanhu varikufamba  vachidarika pedyo netsangamidzi. Mumwe munhu kadzi , uyewo mumwewo zvakare ari  neche kune rimwe rutivi munhu kadzi.
Shangu imwechete iripamubhedha. Inetambo yakareba kwazvo-kwazvo yakatorukirirwa nechakare. Shangu yedivi rekwarudyi inoruvara rwakaita bhuruu, inorubhande ruchena  nechomuzasi kwokunotsika.

Zvishongo zvevanhukadzi zvakarongwa patafura uye zvine ruvara rwakasiyana. Zvimwe zvinoiswa muruoko zvimwe zvinoiswa muhuro kana mumusoro. Zvimwe zvineruvara rweyero, girinhi, rutsvuku, rutema uye zvimwe zvineruvara rweyero.
Nzvimbo inorasirwa marara zvisiri pamutemo.  Iri pedo nemugwagwa une tara uyewo pane dzimba dziri pedo.  Mumarara umu mune magaba , mapepa, mabhodhoro nezvakasiyana-siyana.  Iyi nzvimbo ine tsvina.

Chipukanana chimwe chete chemhando inonzi chitsere. Chinogara mumwena uye chinorarama nekubura huchi chichidya. Chinewo hukasha hwekurwa nedzimwe mhuka dzine ukasha dzakaita senyoka. Chipuka ichi chine mavara akacheneruka nezvitema.
Munhukadzi ane musoro une bvudzi rakasvibira. Rimwe zvakakamwa zvinouya mberi. Rimwe ripfupi parutivi. Akapfeka mhete mbiri panzeve.
Bindu remadomasi, ririkuratidza madomasi aneruvara rwakanaka chose. Madomasi aya atobereka asi haasati aibva zvawo. Pakashandiswawo mashizha kuchengetedza hunyoro hwepasi pemadomasi aya.
Ruva riri mugaba dema, rakabarika kuita zviruva zvidoko zvidoko. Chino unye hunobaya uye hunososona. Chakasungwa netambo kuti chisadonha.

Vanhu vazhinji vanosanganisira varume nevakadzi vari kuita zvakasiyana.Vamwe ndivo vari kufamba zvavo vamwe vakamira.Vamwe vakagara pasi vakatsveta zvinhu zvakawanda zvakasiyana zviri kuratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa zvinosanganisira michero yakaita semaorenji,maepo,mabhanana nemiriwo yakafanana nemakavichi,matomatisi akanyatsokutsvukira chose.
Mugwagwa unofamba motokari. Pane motokari yerudzi rwekombi iri pakati nepakati. Pane zvakare vanhu vari kufamba kurutivi kwemugwagwa uyu kusanganisira vamwe amai vakabereka mwana.

Musha unoratidza kuti une dzimba mbiri, Imwe yakavakwa namarata ikapendewawo kunze kwayo, kwozoita imwe yakapfirirwawo nehuswa. Pamberi pedzimba idzi pane munhurume akamira akatarisanawo nemombe yakamira  kumberi kwake.
Varume vari kutamba nhabvu munhandare. Mudhuri wechivakwa une ruvara rwegirinhi nemarata ane ruvara rwegirinhi.

Vanhurume vanoita mutambo we basket ball varikuona varipanzvimbo yavanotambira, vechifara  senge varikupembera mumwe asina kupfeka hembe yekumusoro. Mumwe arikuonekwa akasimudza hembe yake nechemudenga yaabvisa. Nechekuseri kurikuonekwa zvituro zvinogarira vanhu.

Mazondo maviri ari kubhururuka nechemudenga, muzasi macho muri kuratidza bundo riya rinowanikwa pane mwando kana kuti mujinga mwerwizi rinonzi shanga rakadvibira. Rinowanzoshandiswa nevazhinji kugadzira mhasa kana rukukwe.
Vanhu varikutengesa vakagara pamusika, vamwe mai vakagara vakapfeka heti yeruvara gweyero. Mberi kwavo kunemasaga akaisiwa zvunhu nemigomo yakatsindikigwa pasi michena.
Gwenzi rimwechete rakarerekera  kumhando yeRozimeri.  Rina mashizha akawanda akasvibirira uyewo rina mapazi akawanda.  Mujinga munewo sora ririmo rakasvibirira.
Ruoko rwemunhu rwakabata damba rakatsemurwa, mukati maro mune matamba akatsvukira uye mango mbishi ine ruvara rwegirinhi.
Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa unetara, miti mizhinji ine mashizha akasvibira, motokari ichena, silabhu, zvimiti zvidiki zviri pamusoro pesilabhu zvakachekererwa zvakanaka zviine mashizha akasvibira.

Ndiro ine mavara ine chikafu chakabikwa zvakaisvonaka , chakasanganiswa muriwo, hanyanisi, madomasi, nzondora dzehuku nenyama yemombe. Chakatsvetwa patafura chinoratidza kuti chinonaka kwazvo nekuti chakabikwa zvemhando yepamusoro.

Vana muzvinafundo vanoratidza kuti vangava vakuru vakuru veminisitiri yezvedzidzo. Vari mumusangano wavo. Vanoratidza kuti vanenge vachikurukura maringe nezvidzidzo zvemunyika mavo. Vanhu varimo vamwe vakapfeka masvutu nematai kwoitawo vamwe vakapfeka nhumbi dzekaki dzinoratidza kuti rupfavo rwenzvimbo yavo.
Nzvimbo yakagadzirwa ine masitepusi ekekwira nayo. Kumativi kwemasitepusi kwakagadzirwa nemapuranga ekubatirira mumarutivi
Ndimu dzakakohwehwa dzakawanda  dzakasvibirira.  Dzinoratidza kuti hadzisati dzanyatsoibva.  Dzimwe dzacho dzaka kwasharara dzine mapundu.
Motokari imwe chete itsvuku inobuda pagedhe rine masimbi uye mawaya. Parutivi pane chikebhini chemapuranga chebhurauni. Shure kune marori akawanda nemotokari dzakawanda.
Muchero wakatsvukirira wakakura unonzi koko. Unodyiwa une ruvara rwepepo kuratidza kuti waibva. Uri pamuti mukuru, muti une ruvara rwegirini neruvara ruchena neruvara rwakaita rwamakwati.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti mudhorobha. Parutivi pomungwagwa mukuru wedzimotokari namabhazi pane chivakwa chihombe chomudurukidzwa icho chakaiswa ruvara rwedota. Chivakwa ichi chine mafafitera uye gonhi rakaiswa magirazi anopenya. Potiwo matanho okuendesa kugonhi.

Sango chine zvikwenzi zvakamira zvakanaka. Twakamira tuchiti  apa tumwe apa  tumwe uye tuzhinji twacho ndetwemutondo. Uyewo mashizha acho mamwe ane ruvara rwegirini  mamwe ane  rwakada kuita kutsvukuruka.
Parutivi pemugwagwa pane zvimasimbi. Nechemukati mezvimasimbi izvi mune huswa hurimo uyezve muti wemuchindwi. Nechekure kwemasimbi aya kune chidziro chejuraho.

Munhu akarukwa zvinoyevedza chose. Akarukwa mai mutatu ichidzika. Nechekumucheto kwamai mutatu panoperera  bvudzi rake pakaiswa zvimhete zvichena zvinova zveshongedzo. Uye pakati nepakati pemusoro wake pakaiswa dendenedzwa kwozoti bvudzi rinoita mbumu richierera nechekugotsi kwake.
Mauyu akaiswa mudheka regirazi iro rakagadzikwa patafura uyezve padivi paro pane magirazi maviri akaiswawo mawuyu akanyunguditswa ayo anogona kumwiwa akadaro.
Musikana akapfeka siketi nhema nechipika chichena. Akapakatira bhegi remumooko kuruoko rwerudyi. Mumusoro ane bvudzi rakasungwa nechisungiso chichena.
Mabhasikiti akarukwa neshinda akaisiwa pamutariko. Pazasi pawo pane ivhu dzvuku nesora rakasvibira.
Chivezwa chinoshandiswa mumba mokurara chiri chokuchengetera zvipfeko. Ichi chakapendwa noruvara ruchena uye chinamagirazi okuzviona maviri.

Nzvimbo yakapfumba chose inoratidza kuti inofambwa neveruzhinji. Kune rumwe rutivi kune mudhurii wakavakwa ne zvidhina zvaka tsvukuruka  usina ku purasitwa.  Parutivi rwemudhuri uyu pane murume akagara pasi achiratidza kuti arikuzorora aneta .  Mushure mekunge afamba mutunhu achichovha bhasikoro achitengesa  zvinhu zvakasiyana sezvo parutivi  pake pakamiswa bhasikoro rine zvinhu.
Garwe richiri duku pamuzera. Ririmumvura shomanana. Rinoratidza kuti rinochengetwa pamba nekuti rakapoteredzerwa parinogara newaya chena
Shiri mbiri dziri kuonekera mudenga denga mumuti. Dzakamhara mumuti una mashizha akasvibirira. Shiri idzi dzina mavara machena  nezvitema.
Mumugwagwa unoita seuri pakati pedhorobha. Une mota dzirikufamba. Nechekurutivi kwemugwagwa uyu kune robhoti. Parobhoti apa pakamira mumwe murume anoita seakabereka bhegi.

Vanhu vazhinji vari kuita zvakasiyana. Vamwe varume vamwe vakadzi. Vamwe vakamira vamwe varikufamba. Vamwe ndivo vakagara pasi. Panerumwe rutivi tirikuona chigaba, chibhokisi chine zvimwiwa pamusoro zvinoratidza kuti zviri kutengeswa.

Mugwagwa unetara, mujinga memugwagwa umu munoratidza dzimba dzakanaka dzakavakwa. Imwe yacho inoratidza kuti haisati yanyatsokupera sezvo pane ivhu rakawanda nezvitinha zvakaunganidzwa zvinoratidza kuti zvichiri kuvakisa imba iyi uye kune rumwe rutivi tirikuona kuti hakusati kwatova nemafafitera.
Mukadzi ari pakati peguta . Akapfeka chipika chine mutsara mutema nemuchena. Akapfeka masiki ine ruvara rwebhuruu. Akabata pakati  pemusoro wake.

Imba yomudurikidzwa yakashongedzwa zvakaisvonaka. Ine tsangadzi yakasvibira nemaruva akasiyana. Ine macheya akaiswa pedyo nemusiwo wekupindisa mumba. Ine maruva egirinhi ari kuenda nechekumusoro kwedenga.

Imba ine maruva akarongeka zvakanaka zvikuru akamira akasanagana uye akachekererwa zvakanaka mamwe akareba uyewo mamwe haana . Pasi pane zvidhinha zviripo zvakapindana zvakanaka kuti huite huriri hwamataera hunofadza kuona maziso hune ruvara rwutsvuku.
Nzvimbo inotengeserwa zvidyiwa zvakawanda. Mune madzimai akagara pamisika yavo. Nzvimbo iyi inotengesa zvinhu zvinosanganisira makebheji, maapuro, mabhanana, maorenji nembatatisi.

Pamusika panotengeswa zvekudya. Panavanhu varikutengesa matapiri ari muzvihonwe zvemasagi mahombe.  Kune varikutengesa navari kutenga.  Murume arikutenga akapfeka nhumbi dze bhuruu  mumwe arikutengesa akapfekazve dze bhuruu.  Poita mumwe ane hembe tsvuku  ne tarauzi re girinhi.
Chikafu chesadza, nemuriwo, nenyawa nenyama, nemuto, namagaka zviri mundiro zvakagadzikwa patafura.
Shangu imwe chete yemunhukadzi yokurutivi rwokurudyi. Ine ruvara rwutema muviri wese inewo rubhande rwakaikomberedza rune ruvara rwegoridhe nesimbi iri nechepamusoro yegoridhe.
Pamufanikiso uyu tinoona kuti inzvimbo ine mugwagwa, Parutivi pane juraho. Mufanikiso uyu unoratidza kuti wakatorwa zuva rodoka nekuti bvute rakavharidzira zvisanyatso kuonekera.

Nhandare yemutambo mune vanhu varikutamba mutambo. Vamwe vacho vakapfeka zvichena vamwe vakapfeka zvitema. Nhandare iyi ine huswa hwe girini uyezve yakatarwa mitsetse inoshandiswa nevanotamba mutambo uyu.

Mugwagwa uri kufamba vanhurume. Nechekumberi vatatu vari kuoneka umwe ane sikipa tsvuku vamwe vakapfeka zvitema. Kune rumwe rutivi kune imba hombe yakavakwa inoratidza kunge hoseri iri mukati mefenzi.
Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara. Kumativi kwemugwagwa uyu kune miti yakawanda yakakomberedza ine ruvara rwegirini.
Zvimakabhodhi zviri zvakamiswa divi nedivi, zvichena uyewo zvine tumasimbi twunobatwa nemunhu kana achida kuvhura. Chimwe chine dhirowa negonhi repazasi, chimwewo chakaita saizvozvo.
Chitoro chinotengesa zvakasiyana-siyana kusanganisira shangu, mapatapata nemakiroo. Mukadzi akamira akapfeka hembe yeyero uye umwe wacho akapfeka chikabudura nemapatapata.
Masora akaoma anorakidza kuti ari musango. Pane muti unorakidza kuti une mashizha egirini madiki.
Shangu dzerudzi rwemajombo, dzakagadzikwa pauriri hutsviku. Dzinopfekwa nevanhu vechipurisa kana chisoja, dzakasimba dzinochengetedza makumbo kubva pakukuvara kana kukuvadzwa.

Muti muhombe une mhango. Necheparutivi pane muti muduku une mashizha akasvibira. Pasi pane uswa hwakaoma. Pamberi pane mugwagwa une tara. Nechemhiri kune ruzhowa rwejurahoo mukati maho mune miti mizhinji yemipuranga nemijacaranda ine maruva epepo. Mumugwagwa mune motokari mbiri.

Chikafu chakabikwa zvakanaka ndokupakurwa. Chakaiswa mundiro chena inemakamuri ekuti hapana chinosangana nechimwe. Mumwe mune nyama irimo mumwewo mune mbatatisi dzakasangana nezvinenge mazai koitawo mumwe munetumupunga pozoitawo miriwo yakasangana iri muneimwe. Chikafu ichi chakanaka zvikuru nekuti munhu akachidya anowana zvizhinji zvinodiwa nemuviri saka haazokurumidzi kunzwa nzara.

Uyo mufanidzo wesoshari medhiya puratifomu inonzi imo.Iri kuonekwa ine ruvara rutema nechekunze mukati yoita ruvara ruchena nechikomberedzwa chine ruvara rwebhuruu.Mukati makanyorwa kunzi imo neruvara rwebhuruu.
Zimuti zihombe rine mapazu akatandira akakura chaizvo. Rine mashizha ane ruvara rwegirinhi. Pazasi pezimuti iri pane matombo akawanda chaizvo.
Munhu akabata chuma mumaoko. Chuma ichi chakagadzirwa nesirivheri uye chinoratidza kuti chinoshandisiwa kusvondo nokuti chine muchinjikwa.
Mubhanana wakabereka mabhanana akawanda kwazvo akaibva ane rudzi rweyero nemashizha emubhanana ane rudzi rwegirinhi.
Huruva rine ruvara rwutsvuku. Rune mashizha akakura akasvibira egirinhi. Pasi pane matombo maduku mashoma.

Mudzimai mutsvuku akashongedza nzeve dzake nemhete.Akashongedza zvekare tsiye dzake.Akarukwa musoro neshinda nhema neyegoridhe kuzasi.Akapfeka hembe tsvuku yakanyorwa kunzi American Red Cross.Akamira akatarisa divi ari muimba inoita zvekugadzirwa musoro.
Miti mikuru ineruvara rwegirini irikuratidza kuti miti yakanaka uye iri panemvura. Miti iyi inoratidza kuti irimusango.
Mugwagwa wetara. Parutivi pane masora akaoma uye nechekumberi kune motikari dzakamira mukati memasimbi akakomberedza zvivakwa.
Musikana akamira pamukova wechitoro chinotengeswa zvinhu zvekurukisa musoro. Musikana uyu akapfeka juzi rine ruvara rutema netirauzi ine ruvara rwegireyi neruvara rwekirimu. Akapfeka shangu dema.

Munhandare yemutambo wekiriketi mune varume vaviri  vakapfeka nhumbi dzakafanana dzinova mutodo  mitema uye zvimajuzi zvitema nehembe dzeruvara rweranjisi. Umwe wacho ane chaakabata chinova cheruvara rwebumhudza uye nechekumberi kwake kune bhora diki diki reruvara ruchena.

Guta guru iro ririkuonekwa nezvivakwa zvaro zvakakura chaizvo zvichiturikidzana kuenda mudenga. Kozoitawo migwagwa inemotokari   dzirkuita besanwa dzichienda kwakasiyana-siyana.  Navanhu vakawandawo vanezvavari kufambira .
Muvharo wekirimu uyezve una maruva egreen machena, nepakati pebhurauni uyezve nepamwe pakati kati pe gireyi pe.

Motokari imwe chete ine ruvara rwebhuru yakamira munhu pagoni akabata mukova wacho akafuratira.Uye kumucheto kwayo motikari kune vanhu vakamira vechirume.Umwe akabereka bheke ritema uye neruvara rwebhurawuni uye akabata bepa muruoko rwake.

Nhandare huru ine shanje yakasvibira inoratidza kuti inodiridzwa apo neapo shanje iyi yakagurirwa zvakanaka zvakayenzanirana munhandare umu mune varume vakawanda vazhinji  vakapfeka mudhebhe uye vari kuratidza kuti vari kutotamba mutambo.
Mukati medhorobha pane dzimba dzemudurikidzwa. Imwe ine mufananidzo we munhu nemufananidzo we jongwe nedzimotikari dzakawanda.

Mugwagwa wakanaka une tara.  Mujinga memugwagwa umu  tiri kuona sora  rakoama rinoratidza kuti rava nenguva yakareba  risina kumbonaiwa nemvura kana kuwana mwando zvichibva zvaita tifunge kuti inguva yechando kana nguva chirimo.
Munda une marara uye nemasora akasvibirira kumberi nechepakati kunoonekwa majanga echibage akamira kumberi kwemajanga kunoonekwawo masora marefu akasvibirira

Mudzimai wakafuratira arikuratidza hunyadzvi hwakaiswa mumusoro make. Ane vhudzi dema rinoratidza kuti ivhudzi rekutenga. Obva aita hushongedzwa huri mumusoro. Hushongedzwa uhu tirikuona mabhora akaita machena nemufanidzo wenyeredzi uneruvara rwegoridhe.

Mabhokisi anochengeta chando aripamufananidzo uyu matatu aneruvara rwebhurauni, zvivharo zvacho zvine bhurauni yakasvibira. Akanakira kuisa chikafu kana vanhu vachienda kunoshanya kwakaita sekumapikiniki.
Munhurume akapfeka hembe yakatsvukuruka mukati mebhachi rine ruvara rutema nomudhebhe wakasvibira unoda kuenderana nechibheke chakabatwa muruwoko.
Pane zimuti riri pane matombo akawanda. Zimuti iri rakapa mubvuri kumatombo aya. Nechekure kuri kubudikira dzimba. Uyezve dzimba idzi dzakapendwa.
Motikari dzirikufamba mumugwagwa wetara, parutivi pane bhazi rakamira. Pane imwe motikari yakamira pasi pemuti murefu uye masimbi akayisiwa marata pamusoro panogara vanhu vakamirira mabhazi.

Mugwagwa wetara kurudyi kwawo kune vanhu varikuita mabhizimusi akasiyana siyana. Vamwe varikutengesa mabhanana vamwe varikutengesa rekeni nevamwe varikusunda ngoro. Pane ngoro zhinji kuratidza kuti panotakurwa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana.
Kumberi kwemotikari kunowanika inonzi injini. Ine masimbi akawanda uyewo panoonekwa maburi mana mukati meinjini iyi.
Sango rine miti yakasvibirira neimwe ine ruvara rwegirinhi. Matombo ari musango mahombe. Ivhu rakatsvuka riri pagiraundi.

Pakadyarwa maruva akasiyana siyana. Rimwe reruva rava nemaruva akaita machena. Rimwe racho rine mashizha eyero asi ane girinhi pakati. Poitawo rimwewo riri kubudikira nepakati pemaruva apa rine mashizha epepuro. Maruva aya akanaka zvisingaite.

Vanhu varikuita zvakasiyana vazhinji vacho varikufamba panzvimbo inoratidza kuti inofambwa nevezhinji sezvo yakapfumba. Pane miti mikuru, imwe yacho inoratidza kuti mipaini nesora rakaoma riripasi kuratidza kuti ravanenguva yakareba risina kumbonaiwa nemvura.
Pane mumvuri womunhu urikubudikira pakati pomumwe munda. Munda uyu une huswa, humwe hwehuswa hwacho hunoita sehwakatsva. Padyo nehuswa uhu kune miti iriseri kwechimwe chidzitiro.
Panzvimbo yekutengesera, pane mudzimai akasenga purasitiki jena pamusoro.  Iye akapfeka siketi chena. Arikubva panzvimbo ine vanhu vakawanda.

Munhukadzi akagara pachigaro chine ruvara rwebhuruu. Ari  muimba inoshandirwa naana mazvikokota avo vanova nyanzvi dzekugadzira misoro yavanhu. Ane mhete munzeve dzake uye musoro wake uri kuratidza kuti warukwawo mabhureidzi ane  ruvara rwepepuro nenhundurwa.

Mudhuri wakakomberedza misha. Mukati memudhuri umu dzimba huru nemuti mukuru wemupopo wakabereka mapopo makuru mamwe mambishi nemamwe anoratidza kuti akangavira avakundoibva. Mupopo uyu wakasvibira chose unoratidza kuti unowana mwando wakakwana nemupfudze.

Mbizi shanu dzakamira dzimwe dzacho dziri kuratidza kuti kufura hadzo. Nechekumberi kwacho kune furiramudenga irikuratidza kuti iri kutofamba hayo. Furiramudenga iyi ine mavara ane emakwapa ebhurawuni pamuviri wayo. Pabani padziri pane sora rakawona panoratidza kuti kwava nenguva yakareba pasina kumbonaiwa nemvura.
Shiri imwechete inofamba.  Ine mapapiro akavhurika uye itsvuku. Ine muromo wakareba uye wakapinza. Parutivi pane mashizha egirini emuti.
Kabhazi kachena zvimwe karikushandiswa kutakura zvinhu kwete vanhu. Kamira panowanzomira marori anowanzotakura zvinhu. Kuti zvimwe mutyairi ambozorara uye zvakare ambowana zvekudyira.
Madishi akarongedzwa akaturukidzana turikidzana rine rineruvara rwe bhurawuni,rimwe rineruvara rwekofi, rimwe rineruvara rwe girini.Madishi aya ndeyekushandisa mudziwo wemumba ari epurasitiki.

Nharaunda ine dzimba dzakavakwa kuti vanhu vagare. Iri kuoneka imba yakavakwa yakadzokera kumashure uyewo padhuze nayo pane zvitinha zvakaiswa zvinhu zvinenge hembe pamusoro. Kumberi kwayowo kwakarimwa mahanyanisi nemuriwo nechibage chiviri uyewo kune mumengo.
Chikwangwani chine zvakanyorwa chine mufananidzo wemunhu chiripamadziro pemudhuri wakavakirirwa neivhu. Nhandare ine marara nemota dzakamira nedenga rine makore machena.
Vanhu vakawanda, vamwe vakagara , vamwe vakamira . Vakagara varikuratidza kuti vakadzi.  Vakadzi ava  vari kutamba mutambo wechirungu unonzi Chesi.

Nzou dzakawanda dziri kufamba, nzou idzi dzine mavara akasiyana. Iri pamberi ine ruvara rwebhurauni yobva yaita nyanga dzine ruvara ruchena nemavara matema anoonekera nechekure. kumashure kune dzimwe nzou  dzineruvara rwakachenerukira, koita chimwana chenzou chine ruvara rwakachenerukira nemavara matema anoonekera nechekure.

Varume vaviri vakamira kwozoitawo munhukadzi. Varikuratidzawo kuti vane zvavakamirira. Umwe wacho wakapfekawo masiki yakavhara mhino pamwe chete nemuromo. Vanhu ava vari muguta rine zvivakwa zvakasiyana siyana uyewozve pane mugwagwa uri kufamba dzimotokari dzichiendawo kwakasiyana siyana.

Varume nemadzimai vakawanda. Vakagara patafura vakatarisa vanhu vari mberi kwavo. Tafura iyi yakawaridzwa machira ane ruvara ruchena neruvara rwegoridhe. Vanoratidza kuti vari pamutambo unoitwa zvetsika nemagariro.
Iyi indiri inekudya kunoyevedza. Ndiro iyi inoita seine nyama  yemombe  ine mafuta, uyezve  mundiro umu mune muto wakakokera wakabikwa nemadomasi.
Muchero wama sitirobheri uri mumunda uchangotanga kukura.Uyezve makaiswa mashizha kuti achengetedze unyoro hwemvura.
Zvidhori zviri mukati memba zvakapfekedzwa yunifomu yakasiyana siyana, zvidhori izvi zvimwe zvine yunifomu tsvuku zvimwe zvine yunifomu yogireyi zvimwe zvine hembe dzakasiyana siyana.
Motokari huru yakamira pamugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara wakatsemuka. Motokari iyi ine musoro une ruvara ruchena uye tirera yemotokari iyi ine ruvara rwegireyi.

Nzvimbo ine matombo akawanda mamwe acho makuru. Akakomberedzwa  namarara akasiyana anosanganisira majanga echibarwe zvinobva zvaita kuti tizive kuti pange pakarimwa chibage chikakohwewa pakasara majanga.

Mugwagwa unetara, mujinga memugwagwa uyu munoratidza kuti mune miti mikuru yemijakaranda. Pasi pemiti iyi pane sora rakauma zvinobva zvaita kuti tione kuti rava nenguva yakareba risina kumbowana mwando kana kunaiwa nemvura.

Mbambaira dzinova idzo chirimwa chinodyarwa navanhu.  Dzinoita zvokuchererwa muvhu  dzokura kunze dziine mashizha egirinhi dzobereka pasi.  Kana dzichinge dzaibva dzinocherwa pasi pakare, vanhu vachiburitsa mbambaira idzo dzinozodyiwa.

Pane matombo makuru akaturikidzana. Matombo aya anoyevedza. Pasi pematombo aya pari kubudikira miti. Miti iyi mashizha akasiyana. Kune imwe miti ine mashizha akasvibira kozouya imwe miti ine mashizha akacheneruka.
Dzimba, pane imba isina kupendwa. Uye pedo nemimba pane muti ine mashizha egirinhi. Uyewo kunechidziro chejurahoro. Mukati mejurahoro mune imba hombe yakapendwa.

Zambuko rinoratidza kuti rinoerera mvura muzasi sezvo kuzasi kwacho kune bundo rakasvibira rinoratidza kuti rinowana mwando nemiti yemibhanana yakawanda inehutano inoratidza kuti inowana mwando nemupfudze sezvo pari pagukuriro panokukurirwa tsvina yakawanda nemvura inofamba pasi pezambuko iri.
Pane kanzira kari kunanga pane mumwe musha. Kanzira aka kari kupfuura nemusango rine tumiti. Pamusoro pekachikomo pakaita ruvare ndipo pane dzimba nhatu dzakavakwa nezvidhinha.

Varume vatema vanotamba mutambo wekarati. Varume vacho vakapfeka hembe dzakacheneruka kumusoro. Uye vanoratidza kuti vanotambira chikwata chimwe. Vakasungawo pachiuno chavo nemabhadhi. Mumwe murume akapfeka zvichena kuzasi, asi mumwe wacho akapfeka zvitema. Vose havana shangu.
Pane mukadzi akamira pakati pematafura maviri. Mukadzi uyu akabata bhegi. Paneimwe tafura pane mabhegi maviri matsvuku uye machira.

Chikoro chine midhuri yakawanda ine matenga ane ruvara rwakacheneruka . Chine midhuri ine ruvara rwebhurawuni uye mukati mechikoro ichi mune miti mizhinji yakareba. Chakakomberedzwa neruzhowa rwakagadzirwa nemapanera akapendewa neruvara ruchena neruvara rwegirinhi.
Ruzhowa rwakavakwa kuvharidzira midhuri mukati. Rwakavakwa ruchishandiswa simende nematombo madiki. Mukati meruzhowa umu mune miti uye marara. Sora ririmo rinoratidza kuti raomerwa.
Munhurume akamira pachikwangwani chakanyorwa noruvara rwegirinhi uye chakanyorwa neuvara rwebhuru. Mugwagwa unofamba motokari, miti nemakomo.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti zuva ravakuvira kwavakutanga kusviba. Iro zuva ravakuwonekwa nechekure kure. Pane miti isingachaonekwi ruvara rwayo asi inoratidza kuti haina kuoma. Panoonekwawo pauro remagetsi rakamira munzvimbo iyi.
Padivi pemugwagwa une tara paine zvidzimba zvinotengeserwa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana nemunhu wechidzimai akamira pamugwagwa.

Vanhu vazhinji  vamwe vacho vari kufamba zvavo mujinga memugwagwa. Mune mumwe murume akapfeka heti yakati kurei yekaki. Akapfeka sikipa chena ine mitaro mitsuku inotenderera. Kumusana akabereka bheke dema. Parutivi pake pane mota yakamira  mujinga memugwagwa. Nechekumberi kwacho tiri kuona midhuri mikuru yakanaka. Zvatiri kuona apa zviri kuratidza kuti nzvimbo iyi iri mudhorobha.
Midzi ine ruvara ruchena. Midzi yacho yakadarika nepakaita matombo ichipinda muvhu, panewo tumashizha twegirini turikuoneka kumusoro.

Sadza riri mundiro ine ruvara rutsvuku. Sadza iri rine ruvara ruchena uye riri kudyiwa nemazai akakangwa akaiswa muto mutsvuku pamusoro. Pane girazi rine zvokunwa rine ruvara rweorenji rakagara padhuze nendiro iyi.
Mudhorobha pane dzimba dzine matenga akagadzirwa neruvara  rwakasiyana-siyana. Mamwe matsvuku mamwe matema, namataira akaunganidzwa pabani pane marara nehuswa hwakaoma.
Michero iri mukati mechitoro murikutengesewa yakaderedzwa mitengo.
Mukadzi akabereka mwana netauro. Kumberi kwake kune murume akabata zvinhu mumaoko zvaakatarisa. Kuruboshwe kwavo kune mugwagwa une tara uye kune zvitoro zvakaita mudhadhadha
Bhutsu mbiri dzakagadzikwa pasi. Dzinetambo, ruvara ruri rutsvuku, chena uye tema.
Varume varikutamba mutambo we (tag of war) varikudhonzerana tambo. Vakamira vakapfeka zvitema. Vakapfeka nemakepesi matema.

Vatambi vemapoka maviri akasiyana vakamira vamwe akakotama vakapfeka nhumbi dzine ruvara rwakasiyana vamwe vakapfeka nhumbi dzine ruvara rwebhuruu uye ruvara ruchena vamwe vakapfeka nhumbi kumusoro nekuzasi dzine ruvara rutsvuku.
Bhokisi reruvara rwe bhuru rakavurika rakarongedzerwa zvinhu zvinoshandiswa kudirowa. Zvichiverengera zvigero mapenzura akasiyanasiyana aneruvara rwe bhuru,rwe girini neruchena koita nependa dzacho.
Mugwagwa une tara yave nemakomba makomba kumativi kwemugwagwa kune huswa uye majuraho pamwe chete nemiti.
Zvigaba zvinogara muimba yekubikira mukicheni kana kuti mupandiri munochengetwa chikafu. Zvine chikafu mukati anonzi ma 'cereals ' kana kuti maporiji echirungu.

Mureza unomirira imwe nyika une ruvara rutsvuku kuruboshwe rutsvuku kurudyi pakati paine ruvara ruchena asi pakati ipapo paine mufananidzo uripo une ruvara rwegirini  rwemashizha nemhuka iripo nezvimwe zviripo.Mufananidzo uyu nemuvara uyu une zvaunomirira kunyika iyoyo.
Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa netara urikuratidza kuti muguta. Mugwagwa uyu uri kufamba zigonyeti ziguru rine tirera yakareba. Gonyeti iri rine musoro une ruvara ruchena nemuviri une ruvara rwe bhuruu.

Mureza wenyika yeLibya wakaiswa mavara matatu. Kumusoro kune ruvara rutsvuku. Pasi pane ruvara rwegirinhi. Pakati pane ruvara rutema apo pakaiswa mucherechedzo wemwedzi nenyeredzi izvo zvine ruvara ruchena.
Mundiro ichena inopwanyika mune supu yakawanda yemadomasi itsvuku. Pakati payo panenyama yakabikwa zvakanaka yechikeni nekerotsi yeorenji kuruboshwe kune poteto rakaita yero.
Nzvimbo inehunyoro, uswa hwaakuoma. Pane dzinde rehuswa hwenhokwe nehumwe huswa hwakaoma. Nechekunze kunemiti inemashizha akasvibira nemapazi mamwe akaoma. Kwakakwirira sekune chikomo.

Mharadzano dzemugwagwa une tara. Mharadzano iyi ine ma robots ano controller mota. Mumugwagwa umu mune mota dzemhando dzakasiyana dzirikufamba. Mujinga memugwagwa umu mune vanhu vanosanganisira vakadzi nevarume. Vamwe vakamira vamwe varikufamba.  Vamwe ndovakagara pasi vachiratidza kuti varikutengesa.

Pedyo nemugwagwa pane mumwe musha.  Mugwagwa uyu urikubudikira besu remota.   Nechepamberi pemotokari iyi pane gedhi reimba.   Imba iyi yakapfirirwa nemarata.  Uye chidziro chayo che jura  woru chakavakwa nematombo.
Vhudzi refu rakasvibirira rinoratidza kuti ndere kugadzirira rakaiswa zipu namavara matema nezvichena parutivi bvudzi iri ririwo mumusoro momunhukadzi mutsvuku mutete.

Pamusika panotengeswa zvinhu zvakasiyana siyana.   Zvinosanganisa zvomuchitoro zvokudya nezvirimwa.  Pane motokari dzine mabhokisi  dzokutakura zvinhu zvabva kuvarimi kuunza kumusika. Pane rori chena ine ruvara  rwebhuruu uye pane vazhinji vari kutenga nekutengesa.

Migwagwa iri kusangana iyo inofamba  dzimotokari dzinotakura vanhu kubva pane imwe nzvimbo kueenda pane imwe nzvimbo. Kozoitawo dzimotokari pamwe chete nema duta vanhu izvo zvakamira zvirikuratidza kuti  zvakamirirawo kutakura vanhu.

Chidziro chine zvinhu zviri kuoneka kunze kwacho zvakawanda. Pane makwenzi mamwe aripowo achiri madiki nezvimasora, poitawo mashizha akadonha mumuti akazarawo pasi anoruvara rwebhurawuni. Anogona kushandiswa semanyuwa anoiswa mumurivo.
Pamusika parikutengeswa miriwo yekabichi. Uye mukomana namurume arikufamba kunzira. Uye chingoro chakamira kunze kwenzira pedo nemusika.

Pamusika unotengeswa zvirimwa zvinodyiwa mavegitebhoro .Pane chingoro chakamiswa chakabatwa neruoko chakasungirwa tambo nemawaya. Mberi kwacho pana mai vakagara pachigaro chedanda vakapfeka nguo chena dzechipositori nefasifoto chena vari kutengesa vakatarirana nembatata. Mberi kuna mbatatisi namaonyeni emusoro mukuru.

Bhazi re gold class jena. Rine ruwara ruchena muviri wese nemitaro mitatu mutsvuku we girini nebhuruu. Rikufamba mutara ririkuratidza kuti rakananga ku guta reHarare. Mudivi macho munoonekao muine zvidzimba munoonekao muine vanhu.

Vanhu vari kuratidza vari mukati menhandare iyo inoitwawo makwikwi ekumhanya.  Izvi zviri kuonekawo nemitaro inofanira kunge iri pane munhu ari kumhanya. Vanhu ava vakapfekawo nhumbi dzinoita kuti vange vachigona kumhanya zvakanaka.
Imba isati yava nedenga inotaridza kuti ichiri kuvakwa. Jecha richiri rakaunganidzwa rakakomberedzwa nezvitinha kuti risapararire kwose. Pane mutaro wemagetsi unoonekwa unopfuura nepamusoro peimba.
Muchini muchena uri pasi wakatsvetwa pane ruvara rutema une tambo chena. Pane pepa riripo rine ruvara ruchena nemavara matema. Pane simbi dzakapfurirwa mapepa repurasitiki.

Zvivakwa zvakasiyana siyana zvakakomberedzwa namajuraho. Pamberi pezvivakwa izvi pano ratidzawo kuti pane mugwagwa unofamba dzimotokari  dzichitakura vanhu kuenda kwakasiyana siyana. Zvakare panewo miti  uye dzimwe motokari dzakamira nevanhu varikufambawo vachienda kwakasiyana.
Miti yegirinhi iri parutivi pemvura izvo zvinoita kuti igare ine hunyoro. Mukati munenge mune zvinogara mumvura zvakasiyana zvakaita sehove nyoka.

Dzimba dzakanaka dzakavakwa nemutoo wakada kufanana nezvidhinha zvakanaka zvisina kupurasitiwa kana kupendwa. Paruvazhe pedzimba idzi pane bundo shanje inoratidza kuti hainyatsodiridzwa sezvo ichiratidza kuti haina utano.

Midziyo inoshandiswa mumba yekubikira yakarongedzwa kuti itengeswe.Pane chipunu chine ruvara rwesirivha chakamira chirikumberi kuseri kwacho kune mapanga akawanda anezvipakato zvemapuranga . Uyewo mamwe ane ruvara rutsvuku mamwe ane ruvara rwebhuru mamwewo ane ruvara rwegirini.

Nzvimbo inogona kuwanikwa muguta ine mugwagwa wakaiswa  tara uyewo pane motokari dzakati wandei, mugwagwa wacho wakaiswa mwenje uye une zvikwangwari zvevanhu vanoshambadza zvinhu. Kumberi kurikuonekwawo dzimba , kunewo miti yakareba irikutarisirwa.
Dendere reshiri rakavakirwa mumuti womugwavha una mashizha mashoma shoma.
Musango mune muti wemupangara muduku une minzwa  dzakapinza uye twumashizha twudiki twegirini. Pasi pane huswa hwakaoma.
Furasiki yakakura kwazvo ine rudzi rutsvuku nemuvharo mutema iri kutengeswa muchitoro.
Maruva akaiswa mumagaba aneruvara rwegirinhi nemadodzi-madodzi machena . Maruva aya akawanda chaizvo uye arimumagaba aneruvara rwutema, mamwewo arimumagaba aneruvara rwunonjenjemera.
Zvuma zvemuhuro zvakapfekedzwa pachidhori kuitira kuratidza vatengi. Zveruvara zvesirivha zvinopfekwa nevanhurume kana vanhukadzi kuri kuda kutaridza mucheno wawo.
Varume nevakomana vanoimba vamwe vanoridza  hosho vamwe vanoridza  ngoma. Varidzi vengoma vakagara pazvigaro zvitatu vachiridza ngoma vakapfeka hembe dzine ruvara rutsvuku.
Bhazi riri kufamba mumugwagwa. Bhazi iri rinoratidza kuti ndereCity Link. Rine ruvara ruchena. Nechekumusoro rine mahwindo ane ruvara rutema. Kumberi kwaro rine ruvara rutema neruvara ruchena.

Nzvimbo iri kuonekawo iine miti pamwechete nesora. Kozoitawo mapango akachererwa ayo akasungirirwa tambo dzinodarika nemagetsi. Tambo idzi dzinenge dzichienda kudzimba dzevanhu muguta kana kune dzimwewo nzvimbo kunoda magetsi.
Pombi dzinofambisa mvura. Dhuramhi remvura riripamusoro pezvidhina. Miti inemashizha eruvara rwegirinhi. Fenzi yakakomberedza midhuri.

Mugwagwa unetara. Mumugwagwa umu mune motokari zhinji dzemhando dzakasiyana dzirikufambamo. Kune rumwe rutivi kune murume arikuratidza kuti arikuita minana sezvo achifamba pamusoro pataira. Nechekumberi kuri kubuda midhuri mikuru yakanaka chose.
Nzvimbo ine dzimba dzakanatsovakwa dzakaita mudhandanda. Mudhuri uyu wakavakwa wakareba kubvapaiswa magoni panze akaita mudhandanda. Magoni aya aneruvara rwakachenerukira.

Dzimba zhinji dzimwe  dzirikuratidza kuti dziri kuvakwa sezvo pane Imwe inoratidza kuti ihuru isati yave nemikova nemafafitera uye haisati yarurwa denga. Dzimwe dzinoratidza kuti  zvimukuku  zvakavakwa nemapuranga zvakapfirirwa nemazen'e.

Murume ari kufamba mudhorobha, paanofamba panoratidza kuti pane madhaka, ari kufamba achiita zvekudanhuka.  Wakabereka bheke kumusana.  Mberi kwake kune vakabereka vana vamwe vakabereka mabheke, vamwe vari kutaridza kuti vari kutengesa zvinwiwa.
Ruwoko rwemunhu rwakabata tochi imwechete itema kumusoro kwayo ndekwe bhurawuni uye yakabaka.
Mudzimai wechidiki ari kuyambuka mugwagwa.Kumusoro wakapfeka hembe chena.Wakapendekera bheki dzvuku ridiki.Kuzasi akapfeka hembe ine mavara machena nematema.Kuma kumbo akapfeka gogo.

Mota huru irikufamba munzira. Ine ruvara rweyero uye yakakura zvikuru. Ine kumasure kwekuti kunogona kusimudzika kuchirasa zvinhu kodzokera. Zvinoita kuti inzi Tipper. Uyezve ine mavhiri akawanda zvikuru anosvika kugumi nemana. Mavhiri aya makuru uye ane pakati pesirivheri. Imota yakanaka inobatsira pakuita mabasa ekututunura zvinhu zvingade kutakurwa zvinorema.

Michero mizhinji yerudzi rwepashoni . Ine ruvara runoyevedza rwegoridhe uye mimwe mishoma une ruvara rwakatsvukira. Umwe chete  wakagurwa nepakati zvakaisvonaka uchiratidza mhodzi mukati nhema uye munyepfu weruvara rwegoridhe.

Chibage chinyoro chakatsvetwa pasi. Chinooneka kuti chinyoro nekuda kwemakanda aripasaidhi aneruvara rwegirinhi. Tsanga dzachona dzineruvara rwuchena. Pane tumatambo-tambo tunowanikwa pachibage turipo tuneruvara rwuchena zvakare.

Muchero wemauyu uri mukati mendiro yegirazi. Muchero uyu une ruvara ruchena neshinda shinda dzine ruvara rutsvuku rwakachenerukira uyezve pane mukombe uripo wakazara chimwiwa chemuchero uyu negirazi rimwe chete zvakare.
Nzira inofamba nevanhu vetsoka. Inofamba ichienda panzvimbo panocherwa mvura. Panzvimbo iyi pane vanhu vakawanda vane midziyo yekucheresa mvura.

Mugwagwa unoratidza kuti une tara uye unofamba motokari zhinji. Parutivi rwemugwagwa uyu pane zvimukuku zvakavakwa ipapo nezvinhu zvakatsvetwa. Panoratidza kuti panogadzirwa mipfuku yemapuranga inotengeswa sezvo imwe yacho isati yatopedza kugadzirwa.

Musoro mukuru wegonyeti wakamiswa pedyo nemba. Une musoro muchena woitawo mavhiri makuru matema akavharwa nezvinhu pamusoro. Uyewo une pamwe chena parikuoneka. Wakamiswa pedyo nemba yakati kurei uyewo kurutivi kune karuzhowa kariko kapfupi.

Murume arikufamba ari mujinga memudhuri pakati pedhorobha. Murume uyu akapfeka nhumbi yokumusoro ineruvara rwe bhuruu nechikabudura chineruvara rutema. Akabata zvidhori zvitatu  zvihombe zvaari kutengesa. Zvidhori izvi zvine ruvara rwe pingi, bhuruu uye ruvara rutsvuku.
Munda wamabhanana unoonekwa uyewo ivhu idema.  Kunze kunoratidza kuti kwange kwava kuvira kana kuti mvura yainge yoda kunaya.
Nzvimbo ine zvivakwa zvomudhadha nezvimwe zvomudurikidzwa zvinoratidza kuti pangangova pari pachikoro.   Pane mugwagwa uyo une motokari yemhando diki  ine ruvara rwesirivha.
Nzvimbo yedhorobha ine vanhu vakawanda, kwekutanga kuno kune mukomana akapfeka hembe inemitsetse michena nemitema akabereka bhegi, mberi kune chitoro chinotengeswa mapiritsi nepamwe motokari.

Dhorobha rine midhuri yakawanda ine makamuri akavakwa achienda mudenga. Padivi pemidhuri iyi pane migwagwa mikuru iri kufamba motokari dzakawanda dzine ruvara rwakasiyana rwunosanganisira chena, sirivheri neruvara rutema.

Ichi chinonzi chidhambakura.Chinowanikwa mumatombo kana mumiti.Chinorarama nezvipukanana zvidiki zvinowanikwa muivhu.Chinowanzogara,chinowanzofanana nenzvimbo yachinenge chiri zvakafanana nedombo kana muti.

Pane imwe nzvimbo iri pedyo nemugwagwa pane varume vakagara nokumira panotengeswa matayi. Varume ava vanoita sevari kutaura nyaya. Umwe wevarume ava akapfeka hovhorosi kozotiwo umwe akamira akapfeka vhesi.
Panezviringa zuva zvina. Paneva neimwechete ichena , nhatu dziridzitema. Mbiri dzakabaka dzinototitaridza chiringazuva. Dzimwe mbiri dzakadzima.

Munhandare munoratidza kuti ndeye National Sports Stadium. Mune vanhu varimo vakamira vakapfeka nguwani ine ruvara ruchena  nerwepeporo nechipika chine ruvara ruchena nerweyero.Pane uswa hune ruvara rwegirini uye nhandere ine ruvara rwutsvuku  nezvigaro zvekugara kumusoro kwenhandare.
Imba imwechete yakavakwa nezvidhina ine musuwo wemarata nemasimbi ebhurauni. Chikwangwane chichena, shedhi iriparutivi.
Shangu imwe chete yekurutivi rwerudji ndeyemhando yetenese, yakavarika inemaburi zvinoratidza kuti ndeye tambo.Ineruvara rwepinki muviri wese nezvichena,uye yavakuratidza wo kuti yave kushakara.

Vanhukadzi vari munhandare inotambirwa mutambo avo vari kuratidza kuti vari pakudzidzira kutamba mutambo wavanoda kutamba. Nechekunze kwenhandare iyi kuri kuratidzawo kuti kune jurawori iro rakakomberedza zvivakwa.
Patsvimbo yekutengesera pane vanhu vakawanda. Vamwe vari kufamba vachipesana. Nechekumashure kuri kuoneka mudhuri wakavakwa zvemudurikidzwa.
Nzvimbo irimudhorobha guru reHarare umo munezvivakwa zvomudurikidzwa panewo vanhu vakawanda varikupesana. Nechokumberi kune chivakwa chihombe cheJoina siti.

Mudhuri wakareba kuenda mudenga.  Wakavakwa zvemunhurikidzwa.  Unemafitera mahombe. Pamberi pane motikari chena ine mafafitera matema.  Kumashure kwemota kune vanhu vaviri vari kufamba umwe akapfeka jazi dzvuku.

Vanhu vakagara vakateedza zvitoro vachitengesa zvinhu zvavo. Pane vakawanda vakapfeka zvima hapuroni  zvinoratidza kuti varikutengesa majusi kadhi  ekuisisa mari munhare mbozha. Uyewo pane mumwe arikufamba pauriri hwakagadzirwa namataera zvakanaka.
Chivakwa chemudurikidzwa chakavakwa zvakayesvonaka. Chivakwa ichi chizere mafafitera. Pane motikari yakamiswa mujinga mechivakwa ichi. Tinoonawo tambo tsvuku dzakasungirwa pamatanda.
Pamberi pechidziro chinoita sejuraho pane huswa hwakaoma uyezve mugwagwa une marara. Nechekumashure kwechidziro ichi kune muti murefu uyezve pedyo nawo pane tambo dzemagetsi
Vakoma vebhora vakachonjomara vakabata mabhora avo maviri mumaoko. Vakapfeka hanzu dzekutambisa bhora. Varikusekerera kuratidza kuti vakagadzirira kupinda mumakwikwi nemufaro.

Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti inzvimbo inokanyirwa zvidhinha nekutengesa zvidhinha. Zvidhinha izvi zvakasiyana siyana. Tinoona zvihombe nezvidiki uye zvidhina zvacho zvimwewo zvichena zvimwewo zvakatsvuka. Panewo masaga anoratidza kuti masaga aya ane zvinhu zvinoshandiswa pakukanya zvidhinha.
Iyi imba ichena inoratidza kuti yava nemakore akawanda yavakwa uye ine mataira pamusoro semarata. Madziro mune bhasikoro nemataira nezvinhu zvinoita kunge huni.

Nharaunda yapachiteshi chamabhazi. Panoonekwa vanhu vanotengesa zvirimwa nezvinhu zvakasiyana siyana. Zvinosanganisira madomasi, zvinwiwa nezvimwewo zvakadaro  . Panoonekwawo matanda anopa chiyedza kana kwava nerima. Uye zvikwangwani nema amburera anovharidzira  zuva.
Pedyo nemumwe mugwagwa. Pane rudzitiro rwewaya rwakaiswa. Nechemukati mewaya  iyi mune motokari yakamira pane mumwe musha. Musha uyu une dzimba dzakavakwa nezvidhina dzakapfirirwa nemarata.
Mundiro mapakurwa chikafu chirikutora moyo mune mupunga muchena uye nyama yakangwa zvakaisvonakisa yakasangana nemadomasi nemakoroti.

Nzvimbo ine midhuri mitatu. Imwe yemudhuri uyu ine makamuri akaturikidzana achienda mudenga. Pamhiri penzvimbo pane kasango kane huswa netuzvikwenzi zvakawanda. Huswa uhu humwe wakaoma humwe hune mashizha egirinhi.
Motikari yemhando yegonyeti, inoshandiswa kutakurisa zvinhu zvinorema. Musoro wayo wakandotsvukuruka uye mavhiri matema. Pamativi pemavhiri pane ruvara rwesirivheri.
Vanhu vakawanda vakaungana. Vanosanganisira vanhukadzi navanhurume. Pane vanhukadzi vakawanda vakagara pasi poitao vanhurume vaviri vakamira nechekumberi kwavo.

Murutivi memugwagwa munemiti yakasiyana siyana. Miti iyi inemashizha aneruva rwegirini koita mumwe muti unemashizha aneruvara rwakacherukira. Mugwagwa munedzimotokari dzirikufamba. Panemotokari ineruvara rutema.

Musika urikutengeswa zvinhu zvakawanda kwazvo.  Pane murume akagara pachituro anoratidza kuti ndiye arikutengesa.  Pane zvekare mukadzi arikuzvipfuurira zvake achienda kwaari kuyenda.  Pamusika apa parikutengeswa michero yakasiyana -siyana , uye zvihwitsi nezvimwewo zvidyiwa.

Nzvimbo inezvivakwa zvakawanda zvakavakwa pairi zvakasiyana siyana. Zvimwe  hazvina kupendiwa zvimwe  zvakapendiwa. Pane miti yakawanda yakadzwarwa panzvimbo iyi. Imwe yacho miti yemuparumu iyo inoreba ichienda mudenga.

Musikana ari kuonekwa ari mumufananidzo miviri yakafanana. Akarukwa musoro wake zvinomwisa mvura zvichitevedza musoro wake zvichigadzira madenderedzwa zvimwe zvichiuya nechepamberi penzeve yake. Ruoko rwake rwakabata chivhudzi chakasarira chisina kurariswa mumusoro make. Ane chipika cherudzi rwegireyi.
Miti dzakawanda dzakakura dzine mashizha mazhinji uye akasvibira neruvara rwegirinhi. Parutivi pane mugwagwa.
Munhukadzi mutsvuku akatsikitsira. Ane musoro une vhudzi jena rakagerwa nechekumativi pakaiswa mutaro. Pamusoro pane vhudzi rakakuririra rakabvanyangurwa.
Munhurume akafuratira anotamba mutambo webhora remakumbo. Akapfeka nhumbi yeruvara rutsvuku. Akagadzira musoro wake ukapendiwa  zveruvara ruchena. Kumadivi kuri kuoneka vanhu vakamirizika nedzimba.

Bhaibhere shoko raMwari rakavhurwa pamwe chete nechinyoreso chiripo. Rakavhurwa mubhuku yaMapesarema yamakumi maviri nenhatu pavhesi yekutanga inoti ,"Jesu ndiye mufudzi wangu hepana chandingashaiwa".

Mugwagwa une tara unemotokari dzirikufambamo dzemarudzi akasiyana dzirikuratidza kuti dzirikupesana. Mujinga memugwagwa umu muri kuratidza miti mikuru yemijakaranda ine maruva akaita pepuru. Pasi pemuti uyu pane bundo rakaoma. Necheparutivi pane ruzhira rwunoratidza kuti rwunofamba vanhu vanenge vachifamba zvavo netsoka.
Pane imwe nzvimbo mudhorobha pedyo neroboti pane vanhu varipo. Mumwe wevanhu ava akagara pasi kwozoita mumwe akamira akapfeka hovhorosi neheti chena.
Ruoko rwakabata chishongo chinogona kuisirwa zvinhu zvakadai semaruva. Chishongo chacho chineruvara ruchena. Chinewo tumaruwa twegirini twakaiswa kumusoro.
Miti dzakakura dzina mashizha akawanda uye akasvibira ane ruvara rwegirini. Pasi pane ivhu rakaunganidzwa rakakomberedzwa nezvitinha zvidiki.
Motokari dziri kufamba mumugwagwa. Kumativi kwemugwagwa kune dzimba dzakavakwa dzichienda mudenga.
Ndiro yakapakurirwa mupunga. Mupunga uyu une ruvara ruchena kwobva kwaita umwe une ruvara rweyero. Nyama irimo inoratidza kuti yakabikwa zvakanaka, yakanyatsotsvukira  zvakanaka.
Nzvimbo inoratidza kuva  pakatii pesango.  Pane muti wemhuwa usina mashizha. Kumberi kune miti ine mashizha akasvibira.
Mureza mutsvuku wenyika ya Macedonia uine denderedzwa pakati rino ruvara rwegoridhe woita matanda anotenderedza denderedzwa irori aine ruvara zvakare rwegoridhe.
Nyama yakabikwa neunyanzvi yakatsvukira. Nyam iyi inoratidza kuti ndeyemombe. Parutivi rwenyama iyi pane sadza jena rinoratidz kuti rakabikwa nehupfu hwemabarwe.

Shangu imwe chete ine ruvara rwebhuruu nemukati mutsvuku.Yakasimudzwa rurimi.Ine tambo pamusoro.Iri pajira rine tumabhokisi twegirini negireyi.Narowo jira racho riri pamusoro perimwe jira rine ruvara rwepingi neyero.
Mufananidzo weshangu yemunhukadzi. Shangu iyi ineruvara rwakachenerukira. Inosiya makumbo aripanze nechekumashure. Asi kumberi kwayo inoita seinombanyidzira makumbo nekuda kwemagadzirirwo ayo.

Nzvimbo inemiti yakasiyana siyana inosanganisira muti wemumango. Muti wemumango una mashizha aneruvara rwegirinhi. Koita zvakare maruva aripedyo neruzhowa. Maruva aya anamashizha aneruvara rwegirinhi neruvara rwepingi.
Imba ina mafafitera akawanda nemarata matsvuku yakakomberedzwa nemudhuri une zvidhina zvakawanda zvakanaka.

Nzvimbo yakagadzirwa zvakanaka ikavakirwa pasi nemabwe kuitira  pasachereka uye kuti pave pakashambidzika. Miti yakachekererwa zvakanaka uye maruva uye miti yakapfumvutira nemotokari dziri kufamba dzichipfuura.
Vakamira pakati pemazimota makuru maviri. Mamota matsvuku uyewo anekumberi kurikuoneka mafafitera kunogara munhu anenge achityaira. Munhu akamira akabata imwe motikari imwechete uye arikusekerera.
Shangu mbiri dziri pasi dzine ruvara rutema pasi. Potiwo pamusoro sirivha. Dzakavhurika ndedzemativi ose yekuruboshwe nekurudyi. Ndedzemando yamahwashu.

Mugwagwa wetara , kumhiri kwawo kune zvitoro zvinotengesa zvinhu zvakasina. Chitoro chiri kumhiri chekutanga chitoro chinotengesa mapiritsi ekrapa zvakasiyana siyana che Phamacy. Panozoonekwa chitoro chinotengesa hembe che njake njake.

Mugwagwa wemuguta, kuruboshwe kwemugwagwa kwakwa pakwa dzimotokari dzemhando dzkakasiyana siyana, pane mukadzi akapfeka rokwe dema nehembe chena kumusoro, kuruboshwewo kwakwe kunoonekwa midhuri  yemuturikidzaniswa, kurudyi kwkwe kwakwa pakwa dzimwe motokari
Ndiro imwechete yedhaga ichena. Ine zvekudya zvinoti sadza rechibage  chichena, murio uye nyama yehuku yakakangwa yakatsvukira.
Mukomana akapfeka nhumbi dzakafanana kubvira kumusoro zvichidzira kuzasi. Akapfeka nhumbi tsvuku dzine mitsetse mitema uyezve akapenda musoro nebhurawuni. Akapfeka shangu tema.

Nzvimbo yegirinhi inoratidza kuti parutivi rwayo pane musha uyo wakaiswa jurawoo rakavakwa nezvitinha nesimbivo.   Kudivi rekuruboshwe  kune sango rine miti yakasiyana -siyana  netwunzira twudiki twunofambawo nevanhu vanofamba netsoka.
Chitoro chinotengeswa midziyo yemitambo yakasiyana siyana. Minemidziyo yekutamba madhatsi, midziyo yekutamba hoki , neyavanochengeta magedhe. Koitawo midziyo yekutamba mutambo wetenisi nekiriketi.

Nzvimbo iri kuratidza kuti ine huswa husiri kukura zvakanaka. Izvi zvinoratidza kuti panofambirwa nevanhu panotsikwa nguva dzose ndokusaka uswa husiri kukura. Uye panenge panofambirwawo zvakare nemhuka,chero dzemusango chero dzepamba.
Muti wakakura uripadivi neruware. Midzi dzayo dzikuru dziripachena. Pasi pane miti dzidoko uye mashizha akaoma.

Sango rine miti ine mashizha akatsvukuruka mazhinji acho akatowira pasi. Zvinobva zvaitiratidza kuti inguva yechando kana kuti nguva yechirimo sezvo miii iyi ichiratidza kuti yave nenguva isina kunaiwa nemvura uye pasi pawo panoratidza kuti ivhu ririo rakatooma kare.

Vanhu varikufamba mumugwagwa unowanikwa mudhorobha. Pane munhu rume nemunhu kadzi varikufamba vari vaviri vachiratidza kuti vanhu vanozivana.  Poitawo munhu kadzi arikufamba akatakura bheki rake. Nechekurudyi kurikuoneka michero yakarongedzwa nemiriwo zvakaiswa pasi zvakaita matutu kuti vanhu vanoda vauye vatenge.

Vanhu varikutaridza kuti varikuita zvakasiyana. Vamwe varikufamba, vamwe vakagara pasi vakwadza masaga vakaisa zvinhu pamusoro pemasaga aya zvinoratidza kuti zvirikutengeswa zvinosanganisira matomatisi akaunganidzwa akaita zvitutu. Vamwe vacho vanema vakanyora pamapepa kuratidza kuti varikutengesa eyataimu.

Baba vakagara pachigaro vakazendamira pachivezwa chepuranga vachitengesa. Kumashure kwavo kune ngoro izere nezvakasiyana zviri kutengeswa zvakare zvinosanganisira mupunga, suga nezvinwiwa zviri pamusoro zvitsvuku nezveorenji. Murume ari kurudyi akamira pasi pesumburera ine mavara.

Nzvimbo inogara vanhu irikuwedzerwa kunaka nekuwakiwa.   Pane Imba yakapera kudhara ineruvara rwe pingi.  Poita Imwe inemudurikidzwa  yakamirawo nechekumberi, asi pane majecha  akaunganidzwa kuratidza kuti kuvakwa kuri kuenderera mberi.
Tswanda dzinokwana kuita gumi dzakarukwa zvakanakisa dzichisanganiswa mavara. Tswanda idzi dzine mizera  yakasiyana, pane dzimwe dzakati kurei, dzimwe dzakakura zvishoma nedzimwe diki.

Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa nehunyanzvi unoratidza kuti wakawaridzwa zvidhina zvakaforomwa ne simende . Mumugwagwa umu mune vanhu vano sanganisira varume nevakadzi varikufamba zvavo.  Mujinga macho mune vamwe vakatsveta zvinhu pamatafura varikuratidza kuti varikutengesa.  Vakazvivharira zuva nematende makuru akaita sema amburera.

Chimiro chinoratidza kuti chikoro, kana kuti midhuri inogona kunge ichishandiswa sechikoro. Yakapendwa neruvara rweyero nerutsvuku muzasi, uye pane mihomba inoratidza kuti inosimwa maruva, nemiti mikuru uye mavheranda ekuvanda zuva nemvura.
